articleTitle: Image Processing Algorithm Design for Low-Light EBCMOS Devices Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this study, a hardware platform based on the Xilinx 7-series Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) is employed. The design of a Static Storage Control Module and a Median Filtering Module is accomplished through programming in the Verilog hardware description language using Vivado software. The functionality of these modules is rigorously verified through logical validation using Modelsim software. The algorithm is applied to process low-light images captured by a custom EBCMOS image sensor. Comparative analysis with software testing platforms reveals a substantial improvement in image processing speed when utilizing the FPGA-based hardware resources. This improvement allows the processing of 1 pixel per clock cycle. As a result, this work lays the foundation for the design of lightweight, integrated data acquisition systems for the nextgeneration night vision helmet systems.

articleTitle: Improved the Detection Algorithm of Safety Helmet Wearing Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To settle challenges with low detection accuracy of small and strong objects, as well as complicated settings in practical construction scenarios like tunnels, coal mining operations, and building locations, an improved YOLOv8 safety helmet wearing detection algorithm has been established. To begin, the transformer part is the central component of the system. It uses the contextual knowledge stored in the feature diagram to help the model learn on its own and improve the linking of global feature information. Additionally, the bidirectional feature pyramid network (BiFPN) is employed to integrate characteristic data across various dimensions. Finally, important nodes in the network have the 3D weighted attention mechanism SimAM installed. This gets rid of unnecessary background details and focuses more on the unique features of the hard helmet. The experimental findings reveal that on the SHWD dataset, the revised algorithm's mAP (IOU = 0.5) increased by 3.8% to 95%, and the detection speed reached 127 FPS. In crowded, complex, and tiny object instances, detection increased significantly. It meets precision and real-time safety helmet detection standards and introduces a new solution for challenging construction situations.

articleTitle: A Fast Detection Algorithm for Surface Defects of Bare PCB Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Bare PCB (Printed Circuit Board) surface defect detection is an important step in the automated production of PCB. To meet the requirements of production efficiency, the detection must have high real-time performance, therefore we propose the MOP-Block module to replace the C2f module and also improve the YOLOv8 network structure to reduce the inference time. Then, considering that most of the surface defects on the bare PCB are small in size compared with the overall product, we propose the SiLU-SE attention module to enhance the feature map for improving the detection accuracy at a lower computational cost. The experimental results show that compared with the original YOLOv8n, our algorithms improves the FPS (batch=1, without TensorRT acceleration) on the Tesla T4 GPU by about 70.17%, the size of model is reduced by about 77.01 %, the parameters of the model are reduced by about 84%, and the FLOPs of the model are reduced about 53.08%, but map@0.5 and map@0.5:0.95 are only reduced by about 2.6(%) and 0.9(%) respectively.

Author Keywords: PCB bare board surface defect detection

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection in Urban Streets Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming to address the challenges of pedestrian detection in urban street scenes, we propose an improved pedestrian detection algorithm based on YOLOv5. Firstly, we introduce the D-ECA attention mechanism to enhance the model's focus on channel features, effectively suppressing background noise. Secondly, by adding a small-scale detection layer, we expand the receptive field to improve the accuracy of detecting small-scale pedestrians. Furthermore, addressing the issue of low training efficiency in the original loss function, we employ the WIoU loss function to facilitate the model's convergence to higher accuracy. Experimental results on the dense and heavily occluded CrowdHuman dataset demonstrate an increase in precision by 3.4%, mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</inf> by 2.1%, and mAP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50:95</inf> by 2.6%. This validates that the proposed algorithm effectively enhances pedestrian detection accuracy in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: A 40-45 GHz Frequency Divider Employing InP HBT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: 40-45Ghz millimeter wave process superior properties in transmission rate, large, capacity, wide coverage and low latency, which is significant in 5G deployment. Several research have considered buffers and frequency divider based on CML with desired power consumption. However, current research rarely specific in this band, and the output power could only reach −10 dBm which is relatively low. This paper design a 1:2 frequency divider in ADS employing 0.7μm InP based DHBT employing CML D-Latches, focusing on the frequency range of 40-45 GHz. This design optimized input and output buffers aims at improving the power in the specific frequency range with stable work frequency. The results demonstrate that the output ranges from 0 to 12 dBm and concentrates on 8dBm, in the desire frequency range with a sine wave input. The working frequency cover 40-45 GHz.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Visual SLAM Algorithm for Indoor Dynamic Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping algorithms find extensive applications in the field of robotics, holding a pivotal position. However, in the presence of dynamic targets, the positional accuracy of SLAM systems tends to diminish. In order to handle this issue, a dynamic visual SLAM algorithm based on deep learning is proposed in this paper. By incorporating the object detection network, it assists the SLAM system in distinguishing dynamic targets, thereby enhancing the reliability in dynamic settings. The experiment results show that, in dynamic environments, this algorithm achieves an average enhancement of 90% in positional accuracy when compared to ORB-SLAM2.

articleTitle: Lane Environment Detection with Only On-Board Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Lane environment detection is a vital prerequisite for realizing autonomous driving in complex scenarios. However, existing methods face significant challenges, primarily containing the absence of lane-level positioning information, the imbalance between accuracy and processing speed, and the prohibitively high cost of equipment. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a hybrid method that combines deep learning and traditional image processing techniques. The proposed approach uses the YOLO (You Only Look Once) for environmental vehicle detection, augmented by a post-processing module that provides detailed lane-level positioning information. Notably, the post-processing stage integrates deep learning and traditional computer vision methods, ensuring a fast detection speed while maintaining a desirable detection accuracy. An additional advantage of the proposed method is its reliance solely on an on-board camera, effectively lowering the equipment cost. Furthermore, the method provides more comprehensive detection by incorporating geometric method to estimate the distance between the ego-vehicle and surrounding vehicles. The proposed approach addresses the aforementioned challenges and provides a comprehensive solution for effective and low-cost lane environment detection. To be specific, our proposed method runs at 58 fps and achieves accuracy at 95.22%.

articleTitle: Decentralized Federated Learning Privacy-Preserving Framework Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Federated Learning is a promising approach for privacy-preserving distribute training, but it still faces trust issues and privacy concerns. To address such problems, we suggest a decentralized federated learning framework (PP-BFL) based on blockchain that introduces a node reputation value mechanism to establish a trusted reputation system and a training accuracy verification mechanism that leverages smart contracts to ensure model accuracy while protecting data privacy. Our framework reduces the risk of privacy violations due to collusive evil participants and encourages honest and active participation by modeling historical performance and ranking participants based on their trustworthiness. Experimentally, we demonstrate that our framework delivers higher levels of privacy protection. Our work offers an innovative solution for privacy-preserving distribute training, and future work will explore how to optimize and expand our approach to achieve even greater security and privacy guarantees.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Dual-Trap Reconfigurable UWB-MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The proposal introduces a small antenna for ultra-wideband multiple-input multiple-output (UWB-MIMO) applications. The antenna comprises two radiating modules, measuring 41mm×25mm×1.6mm in total dimensions. A high level of isolation can be attained by incorporating a “T” structure that overlaps with the grounding plane of the antenna. Additionally, two U-shaped slots can be engraved on the radiation stickers and feed lines, and two PIN diodes can intersect at these slots. This modification alters the structure of the radiating stick in wireless local area networks (WLAN) and X frequency bands, resulting in wave reconstruction. The experimental findings indicate that the MIMO antenna design possesses a resistance bandwidth ranging from 2.5 to 11.8 GHz. Additionally, it exhibits two distinct falling wave frequencies: one between 5.0 and 5.9 GHz and another between 7.0 and 7.8 GHz. Furthermore, the antenna demonstrates an isolation above 20 dB across its entire operational bandwidth. The antenna exhibits favorable radiation characteristics and a low envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) of less than 0.04, making it well-suited for UWB-MIMO systems.

articleTitle: Ship Target Detection Method Based on Berthing Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In port operations, berthing procedures play a crucial role, with ship detection serving as the cornerstone for automation in berthing scenarios. Existing ship detection methods suffer from issues such as low accuracy and slow detection speed. This paper proposes a ship detection method based on the SSD algorithm. The approach leverages dilated convolution to enhance features, utilizes the lightweight MobileV2 network to optimize the model, and ultimately employs the K-means++ method to refine the design of default box ratios. This method achieves high accuracy, rapid detection speed, and a lightweight profile, providing robust technical support for efficient ship target recognition in berthing operations.

articleTitle: Classification of Sleep Stages based on Multiple Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Sleep problems have received much attention from the society and more and more studies have focused on sleep quality and its related diseases, but there is still a lack of high-precision sleep stage identification methods in the field of daily sleep recording. In this paper, we propose an attention mechanism-based sleep stage recognition method, namely the Sleep Stage Attention Model (SSAM), for classifying sleep stages. SSAM uses deep networks for sleep electroencephalographic signal (EEG) features to obtain high-precision sleep signal features. Secondly, we use the attention mechanism to expand the above features for sleep periods to enhance the specific sleep stage. The semantic information of the sleep signal, and the above feature set is transmitted to the subsequent sleep stage recognizer for sleep stage classification. We conducted experiments on datasets Sleep-EDF-20 and Sleep-EDF-78, the experimental results show that our proposed method can obtain higher prediction accuracy than the baseline, which indicates that the use of the attention mechanism effectively improves the sleep stage recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Atmospheric Pollution Gas Concentration Detection System Based on Hybrid Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Due to the limited number and uneven distribution of air quality monitoring equipment, the use of sensors to detect the concentration of polluting gases has become an alternative. However, the gas sensor is prone to aging and is easily affected by environmental variables, resulting in sensor drift. Firstly, in order to find a suitable calibration model to reduce the number of periodic calibration, a hybrid model combining Random Forest (RF), XGBoost and Bi-directional long-term and short-term memory network (Bi-LSTM) is proposed to calibrate and verify the sensor response value. Secondly, the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation was used to optimize the structure of the sensor chamber, aiming at the difference of sensor response value caused by airflow interference and uneven airflow distribution. Finally, an air pollution gas concentration detection system based on RF-XGB-Bilstm hybrid model is developed to measure the concentrations of CO, SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. According to the evaluation index results of R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, RMSE and MAE, it can be concluded that the atmospheric pollution gas concentration detection system developed in this paper has been proved to be feasible and practical.

articleTitle: 3DCSCN: 3D Cascade Shape Completion Network Based On Single Depth View
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Depth images of objects can be easily obtained by depth cameras, but they can only provide limited shape information. Current widely learning-based methods generate complete 3D shapes from images, but reconstructed 3D models have low resolutions and noise. To this end, this paper proposes a 3D Cascade Shape Completion Network (3DCSCN) for predicting the complete 3D structure from a single-depth view. 3DCSCN uses an encoder-decoder network to generate rough prediction results and then introduces a point refinement network to update points with high uncertainty for fine-grained prediction results. The experimental results show that 3DCSCN is better than the current methods by an improvement in average IoU and CE by 0.91% and 3.83% on the public ShapeNet dataset, respectively.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Temporal Action Localization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Temporal action localization (TAL) plays a crucial role in video understanding, aiming to determine the class of each action instance and pinpoint its starting and ending frames in untrimmed videos. This paper introduces an anchor-free TAL approach using a U-shaped network. Through backbone and feature pyramid networks, the input video is transformed into a 1D feature sequence encapsulating the video's spatial-temporal information. By leveraging the U-shaped network-based feature pyramid, spatial dimensions are merged across various temporal convolutional layers, and temporal dimensions are aggregated. Preliminary proposal sequences, which include a basic regressor and classifier, are generated. For each of these proposals, predicted temporal regions are extracted and key boundary features are acquired using a boundary pooling network. These boundary features, in conjunction with the feature pyramid, serve to output refined temporal regression and action classification predictions. Our approach, devoid of predefined anchors, reduces the output volume and complexities of hyperparameter tuning. Experiments on the THUMOSl4 dataset showcase the evident advantages and commendable performance of our anchor-free TAL method.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv7 Aerial Small Target Detection Algorithm Based on Hole Convolutional ASPP
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In response to challenges in detecting small targets in aerial images, such as mutual occlusion, drastic variations in target scale, and difficulty in localization, this paper presents improvements to the YOLOv7 object detection model. Firstly, the CBAM fusion attention mechanism is introduced into the shallow layers of the YOLOv7 Backbone, allowing the model to better focus on target regions and enhance the precision of small target localization. Secondly, the ASPP dilated convolutions are integrated into the SPPCSPC module, increasing the receptive field without introducing additional parameters and thereby preserving more features of small targets. Finally, the Focal Loss classification loss function is employed to replace the cross-entropy loss, reducing the overall loss degrees of freedom and improving convergence. Experimental results on the VisDrone2019 dataset demonstrate that the enhanced YOLOv7 algorithm for small target detection in aerial images performs exceptionally well, exhibiting superior accuracy and effectiveness compared to other classical object detection networks. It meets the precision requirements for detecting small targets in aerial scenes.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Serial Port Controller based on PCIe
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To meet the requirements of long-distance data transmission, high reliability, and fast reception, a PCIe-based multi-serial port controller design scheme is proposed. The design utilizes Xilinx K7 series FPGA chips and incorporates the internal PCIe IP core. Configurable parameters such as serial port baud rate and FIFO depth are employed, enabling simultaneous data transmission and reception for 32 serial ports. Firstly, the system architecture and principles are analyzed. Secondly, detailed designs for PCIe, serial ports, and interrupt controllers are presented, with a focus on analyzing the logic and software processing flow under nested interrupt conditions to avoid improper handling that may cause abnormal operation of the serial ports. Finally, the functionality is verified on an FPGA development board. The results indicate that the designed multi-serial port controller meets the performance requirements for serial ports in industrial automation system integration and provides valuable insights for enhancing device integration.

articleTitle: BER-SISF: Inter-segment Fusion Network Using Emotional Similarity Information for Bimodal Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: For bimodal emotion recognition (BER), a key challenge is to effectively aggregate information from different modalities to improve emotion recognition performance. In this study, we present a dual-modality emotion recognition model that utilizes a segment-level, inter-modal similarity-based fusion method alongside a joint emotion feature fusion technique. This approach leverages inter-modal similarities to create central representation vectors for input sequences, thereby boosting realtime emotion recognition robustness. The model also integrates modality-specific emotional information with cross-modal affective similarities for improved information aggregation. The proposed model is validated on the public benchmark dataset IEMOCAP and achieves weighted accuracies of 84.23% in fourclass emotion recognition tasks, respectively, surpassing other state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Capacity Enhancement of NOMA-Based Satellite-UAV-Terrestrial Network for Maritime Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Space-air-ground integrated network is one of the important visions for future mobile communications, where the problem of utilizing limited resources to serve increasing number of users is urgently to be solved. In this paper, we formulate a capacity maximization problem by joint power allocation and trajectory planning of non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA)-enabled hybrid satellite-unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV)-terrestrial network for maritime communications. UAV shares the spectrum resource with marine satellites and forms virtual clusters with the terrestrial base station (TBS), where NOMA is adopted for the maritime users in each cluster. An iterative resource allocation algorithm is accordingly proposed, which is demonstrated to improve the system capacity by up to 33.3% comparing with existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Quantum Precision Measurement Technology Based on NV Color Center Applicable to Ultra-High Voltage Direct Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Compared to other systems, diamond NV color centers have the advantage of being small in size and can be optically polarized and read out at room temperature. At the same time, its electron spin can interact with a variety of physical quantities, thus forming a multifunctional quantum sensor. At the same time, the excitation and detection of diamond NV color centers are usually not demanding on physical conditions, which makes them highly practical. Based on this, this paper discusses the new quantum precision measurement technology based on NV color centers for ultra-high voltage (UHV) DC measurements, and analyzes the influence of the complex environmental magnetic field on the measured components of the ODMR spectrum in the UHV converter station by the NV color-centered energy level structure and the jump mechanism and the diamond NV color-centered magnetic resonance technology for optical detection. The simulation results show that the surface receiving power of the scheme is 63% of the incident light power, which realizes the high precision measurement of the current and has high sensitivity and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Power OPGW Cable Operating State Early-Warning Method based on CNN-LSTM Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient robustness of the current power OPGW cable early-warning mechanism, this paper proposed a power OPGW cable operating state early-warning method based on CNN-LSTM prediction. Firstly, the data prediction model of power OPGW cable is established based on CNN-LSTM training network to provide the data basis for further early-warning operation, in which the prediction value of OPGW fiber-core strain data-sequence is obtained by means of CNN feature extraction and LSTM data prediction. Then, MLP classification identification model is utilized to make the decision of operating state early-warning for power OPGW cable, in which the prediction data of OPGW fiber core strain is used as the data source. Finally, the experiment is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The experimental results illustrate that, compared with the LSTM-prediction method, the proposed method can improve the prediction MAE of OPGW fiber-core strain data-sequence from 0.046 to 0.038, and the average accuracy rate of early-warning classification reached 96.99%, achieving the effectiveness for the better operation and maintenance of power OPGW cable more efficiently.

articleTitle: Optical Deformation Monitoring Based on Ground-Based Synthetic Aperture Radar Ranging and Regression Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Optical deformation monitoring is a crucial component of three-dimensional deformation monitoring. It commonly employs optical sensors., such as cameras., to detect the pixel deformation of the target. However., it is challenging for a single camera to accurately convert pixel deformation into real-world deformation. In this paper., the detection range of the target is determined using ground-based synthetic aperture radar. Subsequently., the pixel deformation quantity captured by the optical camera is converted into actual two-dimensional deformation using regression prediction. Through the physical experiment., the root mean square error of this method is less than 6%., making it an effective tool for monitoring two-dimensional deformations of targets.

articleTitle: An Online Task Assignment Method in the Dynamic Arrival Scenario of Participants
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Task assignment is one of the critical issues in mobile crowdsensing (MCS) paradigm. For the dynamic arrival scenario of participants, an online task assignment method named OTAPDA, is proposed in the paper. The proposed method adopts a three-layer architecture with trustful edge nodes. To maximize the task completion rate in condition of preserving bidding privacy of participants, a confusion function based on the exponential mechanism of differential privacy is firstly designed at edge level. And then winner participants are selected according to historical completion rate and fuzzy bidding of the participants under silding window. Experimental results on a real dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Atmospheric Delay Inversion by Undifferenced Uncombined Precise Point Positioning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Based on the RTD (Real-time Differential) positioning algorithm, the positioning accuracy of the Beidou-3 signal is analyzed and evaluated, and the algorithm is improved for the new signal to further improve the positioning accuracy of the new signal. This paper innovatively proposes a method to evaluate the performance of pseudo-range positioning by using the atmospheric delay parameters of undifferenced and uncombined PPP (Precise Point Positioning) inversion. It realizes the inversion of atmospheric parameters by server positioning and broadcasts them to the client to improve the pseudo-range difference algorithm of the client. The three-dimensional accuracy of the pseudo-range difference algorithm is improved, and the effectiveness of the method is proved.

articleTitle: Optimal Thresholds for the Guard-Channel Approach in Wireless Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this letter, we study the optimal policy for the guard-channel approach to call admission controls (CAC) in wireless cellular networks. Based on the Markov decision process (MDP) model, we show that the optimal policy is characterized by a switching-curve type of threshold instead of the control-limit threshold which is characterized by a single constant.

articleTitle: Optical communication anonymous security transmission based on blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Information leakage is becoming an increasingly serious problem. When malicious users impersonate a target demodulator, the existing optical communication systems are prone to exposing the data to unauthorized users. Therefore, in the context of optical communication systems, combined with blockchain technology, SM2 and SM3 algorithms are used to encrypt data before transmission. Smart contracts on the chain effectively ensure that data is not forged, while digital signature algorithms enable user identity concealment. The results show that the encrypted data is successfully converted into a binary sequence for transmission, and the original data can be correctly recovered in the blockchain after modulation and demodulation, which improves the reliability and confidentiality of the data transmission process.

articleTitle: Improved Multi-Granularity Cascade Forest Network Traffic Classification Optimization for SDN-Based Differentiated QoS Guarantees
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: How to achieve network quality of service guarantee and provide differentiated demand has been a hot research topic in the Internet field. Based on the data traffic classification problem of SDN (Software Defined Network) architecture, an improved multi-granularity cascade forest network traffic classification optimization model with differentiated QoS (Quality of Service) guarantee is proposed. First, the collected real dataset is normalized using the Z-score method, and the noise and edge samples are eliminated using the A-SMOTE algorithm. Then, the SDN-IgcForest model is proposed to improve the gcForest model by passing the low predictive confidence samples more accurately to the next level of cascaded forests for further training through the split-box method, and introducing the random sampling method to reduce the dimension and number of samples for generating the transformed features during the multi-granularity scanning. Finally, the experiments are conducted in the Mininet+Ryu simulation experiment environment. The results show that the pre-processing with A-SMOTE algorithm improves the classification performance by 8.09% over the SMOTE algorithm, and SDN-IgcForest performs better compared to DCNN, IgcForest and Proposed DFC.

articleTitle: Research on Control Technology of Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This article focuses on the control technology of modular multilevel converter and research modulation technology, voltage balancing of submodule capacitor, and suppression strategy of circulation current. Solutions include: circulation current control based on second harmonic frequency and submodule capacitor voltage balancing based on hierarchical control. Finally, building a simulation platform in Matlab/Simulink to simulate and validate the simulation model of.

articleTitle: Enhanced Channel Modeling and Generation with Reconstructive Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Advancements in deep learning (DL)-based wireless communications have been hindered by the increasing complexity of channel modeling and the challenge of collecting high-quality wireless channel data. This study proposes a novel machine learning approach, the Reconstructive Generative Adversarial Network (ReGAN), which leverages an AutoEncoder (AE) architecture to enhance data generation efficiency. The method was assessed using a comprehensive dataset of various Clustered Delay Line channel realizations, created using MATLAB. The ReGAN model demonstrated high consistency in channel similarity, setting a new benchmark in channel modeling and generation. This approach has the potential to expedite the development of wireless communication systems by offering more efficient and accurate channel models.

articleTitle: Ship Ranging Based on Monocular Imaging and Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Environmental perception, including object recognition and distance estimation, is a crucial aspect in the field of computer vision. Although distance estimation has received relatively less attention compared to object recognition, its accuracy becomes particularly crucial in specific scenarios, such as when ships are entering ports or gates. In such situations, precise distance control is essential, as errors could lead to the risk of collisions between the ship and the dock. Due to significant variations in the sizes of ships, traditional distance estimation methods often exhibit substantial errors. To mitigate these inaccuracies, this paper proposes a self-adaptive ship size estimation approach. In addition to introducing an adaptive model, we further design a distance estimation model incorporating tilt information to enhance the accuracy of distance estimation, especially for objects closer to the camera. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach in improving the accuracy of distance measurements, particularly in overhead perspectives.

articleTitle: SPD Manifold-Based Graph Neural Network for Fault Diagnosis of Harmonic Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Harmonic drive (HD), as an essential component of industrial robots, is susceptible to damage due to product manufacturing and working conditions. Therefore, it is imperative to conduct a comprehensive test to accurately diagnose potential HD faults. In this paper, a SPD Manifold-based Graph Neural Network (SPD-GNN) is proposed to accurately identify different faults of HD. In the time-frequency domain, the high-definition vibration signals obtained from multiple sensors are segmented. The resulting multi-channel spatial covariance matrices (MSCM) act as vertices in a time-frequency graph. A SPD-GNN is then utilized to extract classification details while preserving discriminative capabilities. Subsequently, the SPD matrices are projected to the tangent space using a logarithmic mapping (LOG) layer. Ultimately, the data is input into a cross-entropy loss function for subsequent computation. The SPD-GNN uses graph convolutional techniques tailored for SPD matrices to capture HD features in the time-frequency domain.

articleTitle: Urban rail transit 1500V DC switch trip fault intelligent classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper introduces a classification of 1500V DC switch trip fault based on K-means algorithm. According to the trip duration at the time of the trip fault and the change of electrical volume, scatter diagram is drawn by Matlab, and the Euclidean distance from each point to each cluster center is calculated to complete the classification by comparing the distance sum between the new cluster center and the last round of cluster center. The proposed method aims to classify the DC switch trip faults of rail transit in detail and meet the requirements of rapid maintenance better. Through experimental comparison, it is concluded that when K=7, the SC coefficient of K-means performance index is 0.8326, which is the closest to 1 and the classification is complete compared with other K values, and the effect is good.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Compatibility Network for Zero-Shot Learning Based on Foundation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Deep learning's development in large-scale classification is hindered by its dependency on extensive datasets, which also impedes automated exploration technologies in landscape studies. Zero-shot learning is an emerging solution through knowledge transfer. In this paper, a bidirectional compatibility network for zero-shot learning (BCN-ZSL) is proposed, diverging from traditional methods by employing both visual-to-semantic and semantic-to-visual modules for bidirectional learning. By utilizing foundation models cost-effectively, BCN-ZSL demonstrates enhanced performance over conventional methods, as verified by extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets. Our approach emphasizes on exploring possible cost-effective strategies for applying foundation models in similar contexts, providing valuable insights for future research.

articleTitle: AIS Signal Demodulation Algorithm Based on Joint One and Two Bit Differential Viterbi
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In response to the problem of symbol to symbol crosstalk and high packet loss rate caused by the lack of channel coding in ship automatic identification systems (AIS), a signal demodulation algorithm based on joint one and two bit differential Viterbi is proposed on the basis of traditional one bit differential demodulation algorithms, two bit differential decomposition algorithms, and Viterbi demodulation algorithms, and simulation verification is conducted. The simulation results show that the AIS demodulation algorithm using a joint one and two bit differential Viterbi is overall superior to traditional AIS demodulation algorithms. Under simulation conditions with a frequency offset of 500Hz, when the baseband signal-to-noise ratio is 5dB, the system packet error rate is already less than 20% of the AIS standard requirements. However, when the baseband signal-to-noise ratio reaches 10dB, the system packet error rate can reach 3 × 10–4, which improves the performance by 25 times compared to traditional solutions. The new algorithm effectively improves the reception sensitivity of the AIS system in low signal-to-noise ratio and high-frequency bias, and consumes less computing resources, which has high promotion and application value.

articleTitle: A Next Function Set Scheduler for Serverless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Serverless computing, a dominant cloud-based application development paradigm, allows developers to focus on logic rather than deployment concerns. Despite these benefits, the cold start problem hinders Serverless applications, impacting the performance. Existing research often addresses individual function cold starts, but real-world Serverless applications involve multiple functions and internal dependencies. Furthermore, the prediction of forthcoming dependent functions is not taken into consideration. This paper explores the cold start problem in Serverless application level, proposing Next Function Set Scheduler (NFS) to address this problem. NFS discovers dependences between Serverless functions and derive function sets based on dependences. Additionally, NFS take the prediction of forthcoming function set into consideration to achieve better cold start mitigation performance. We evaluate NFS by conduct experiments on an industrial Serverless dataset. The results show that NFS reduce 28.3% cold start rate for 75% of functions and while having a lower memory usage compared with SOTA methods.

articleTitle: Finding Most Influential Inter-Layer Edges to Enhance Diffusion on Two-Layer Interconnected Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This note is to give the theoretical analysis for the selection of interconnections to maximize the diffusion speed on interconnected networks where two layers are directed. The second smallest eigenvalue (in terms of real part) of the supra-Laplacian matrix is considered as a metric. Based on the matrix perturbation theory, we derive a first-order approximation of the second smallest eigenvalue, resulting in a scoring of inter-layer edges. We propose an algorithm for selecting connector nodes and verify its effectiveness through simulation examples.

articleTitle: Image super-resolution algorithm based on multi-dimensional Swin Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Numerous studies have demonstrated the Swin Transformer performs well in image super-resolution tasks. However, Swin Transformer typically divides the input image into fixed size blocks (such as 48x48) and independently processes each block, causing it to overlook a wider area. Furthermore, many deep learning super-resolution technologies face the challenge of computationally intensive operations. To address these issues, we propose a new NSTSR model consisting of four parts: data preprocessing layer, primary feature extraction layer, advanced feature extraction layer, and image generation layer. The advanced feature extraction layer consists of multiple STNBs (Swin Transformer N-segment blocks). We have introduced a technique called N -Segments, which applies the N -Gram contextual method for natural language processing tasks to low-level visual tasks. In our work, N-Segments refers to neighboring local windows in Swin, distinct from the traditional text analysis definition where N -Segments represents a continuous picture segment. Leveraging sliding-WSA, the N-Segments interact with each other, enabling the expansion of the regions seen to restore degraded pixels effectively. The experimental results demonstrate that the NSTSR model exhibits excellent performance compared to existing advanced methods while maintaining the computational efficiency structure.

articleTitle: Performance Study of Pre-equalization by Neural Network in THz-wave Communication System for 6G and B6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: We propose a joint equalization scheme based on neural networks for nonlinear impairments in 6G terahertz communication systems. The simulation results show that under the transmission conditions of carrier frequency 350G Hz and fiber transmission distance of 50km SSMF, when the LOP is 0dBm, the Q factor of the 16QAM signal can be increased by about 12dB, and the BER can also be increased by nearly an order of magnitude. At the same time, the improvement effect of Q value and BER under different LOP values was also measured to verify the reliability of the equalization scheme.

articleTitle: Automatic Extraction Method of Machining Trajectories Based on Point Cloud Registration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In the application of industrial robots, automated production is a core goal for improving production efficiency and product quality. However, the extraction of complex spatial machining trajectories has always been a challenge for industrial robots. This paper proposes an automatic extraction method for machining trajectories based on an improved Deep Closest Point (DCP) point cloud registration network and B-spline interpolation. By leveraging the Linked Dynamic Graph Convolutional Neural Network (LDGCNN), the feature extraction module of the DCP network is enhanced, and Transformer and SVD modules are introduced, combined with the ICP point cloud registration algorithm for iterative optimization. Initially, the machining trajectory data points of the template point cloud are manually selected, and then the improved DCP point cloud registration network is used to register the target point cloud with the template point cloud, obtaining a transformation matrix. Using this matrix, the machining trajectory data points on the target point cloud are solved, and these data points are further subjected to B-spline interpolation to obtain precise and smooth machining trajectories. Finally, the degree of overlap between the machining trajectories extracted using this method and the actual machining trajectories is above 99%, and the entire process takes less than 0.2 seconds.

articleTitle: An over-temperature protection circuit for smart power switch
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: An over-temperature protection circuit with low temperature protection and power limiting circuit was designed on the basis of high-temperature over-temperature protection circuit. In the smart power switch chip, it prevented the junction temperature of the power transistor and the temperature gradient in the chip from exceeding the safe range, which could damage the chip to varying degrees and affect the reliability of the chip. The negative temperature coefficient voltage was used to detect the chip temperature in real time, and the logic turnover point was obtained by comparing it with reference voltage of the band gap reference circuit, after processing by hysteresis logic circuit the hysteresis logic signals are outputted to control the working state of the chip. The circuit was fabricated with a 40V 0.35 µm BCD process. The simulation results show that when the temperature is lower than -40°C, the low temperature protection circuit is turned on; when the temperature is higher than 175°C, the high temperature protection is turned on, and the hysteresis temperature is 14°C;When the temperature gradient exceeds 60°C, the power limiting is turned on, and the hysteresis temperature is 14°C. It can be applied to smart power switch chips in harsh working environments.

articleTitle: DeepLabV3-SAM: A Novel Image Segmentation Method for Rail Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Image segmentation is vital for improving visual perception in rail transportation. However, challenges like limited public data and high training costs exist. This study introduces the DeepLabV3-SAM model, combining DeepLabV3 and Segment Anything Model (SAM) for innovative image segmentation. By leveraging SAM's zero-shot transfer capability and merging it with traditional algorithms' semantic segmentation proficiency, our method achieves precise and fully automated segmentation with low training costs. This approach not only provides a groundbreaking solution to image segmentation challenges in railway transportation but also extends SAM's application by adding semantic segmentation capabilities. Performance evaluation on the RailSem19 dataset, a publicly available resource for semantic rail scene understanding, shows our method surpasses traditional models like DeepLabV3 and UNet, particularly excelling in segments with large-scale objects and well-defined boundaries. In the majority of cases, our DeepLab-SAM model outperforms traditional models, achieving a 10% lead in the mIoU metric across more than half of the segmentation tasks. Our method excels in achieving high-precision image segmentation with limited training samples and lower costs, offering a novel solution to segmentation challenges in rail transportation and related fields.

articleTitle: A TCP Throughput Model for IEEE 802.11 Linear Multi-hop Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Nowadays, IEEE 802.11 has become the most widely used standard for the wireless local area network (WLAN), and transport control protocol (TCP) is a dominant communication protocol in networks. Besides, the linear multi-hop networks are applied in various scenarios to overcome the limitations of communication range. This paper proposed a novel TCP throughput model for IEEE 802.11 linear multi-hop networks by analyzing distributed coordination function (DCF) and frame transmit queues. It is evaluated the effects of minimum contention window sizes on the throughput by mathematical analysis, and the optimal parameters for the best throughput performance are obtained. The validity of the model is verified through the simulation results.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection of Electrical Data With Scene Differentiation Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The growing openness and frequent flow of electricity data in today's environment pose complex challenges, including pervasive risks of data leakage throughout its lifecycle. This paper proposes a privacy protection method for electricity data using generative adversarial networks (GANs) tailored to scenario-specific variations. The approach involves parsing data interaction interfaces and encoding variables with different feature encoders based on their types and characteristics. A GAN, enhanced with information, downstream, generator loss, and Was+GP improvements, is employed to generate anonymized data, introducing random noise for differentiated privacy protection across scenarios. The Jensen-Shannon Divergence of our model is lower by 0.04 and 0.053 than that of CT-GAN and TableGAN, respectively, demonstrating a significant reduction in statistical similarity differences between the synthesized and original data. This approach effectively replaces the original data for analysis and sharing, ensuring privacy protection.

articleTitle: GC-DBSCAN-Based Dynamic Target Recognition Method for Millimeter Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: “Security in the Transportation of Radioactive Material - Guidelines for Implementation”states that security measures for vehicles transporting nuclear materials in a temporary stopping state during transportation should be consistent with the level of security at fixed sites.The environment of temporary docking is complex and changeable, while the setting of physical barriers is not applicable to the changeable scenarios of the transportation process. In this paper, an optimized millimeter-wave radar point cloud clustering algorithm is proposed from the technical barrier level to be applied to the vehicle-mounted nuclear security early warning system to detect and warn the unauthorized approaching behaviors of suspicious personnel. The method is based on the DBSCAN algorithm, and the grid density division as an auxiliary judgment clustering results in the target motion trajectory prediction of the target motion direction of the compensation of the number of point clouds to comprehensively improve the millimeter-wave radar target identification accuracy, single target detection accuracy can reach 95%, and can effectively and accurately determine the behavior of unauthorized proximity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Cyber Space Threat Detection System Based on User Behavioral Logs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In contemporary society, the role of networks in daily work and business activities is increasingly prominent. The enterprise intranet, serving as a crucial bridge for maintaining work stability, asset security, and business continuity, has garnered significant attention from both academia and industry in the field of intranet security detection. This study is based on the Log2Vec algorithm and involves the design and implementation of a Cyber Space Threat Detection System. The system, facilitated by the collaborative efforts of three modules— log ingestion, graph encoding, and security detection—effectively showcases user behavior, encodes logs into a heterogeneous graph, transforms the graph into vectors, and conducts cluster analysis to detect abnormal user behavior. Through in-depth research and systematic design, this study aims to provide enterprises with a more advanced and comprehensive intranet security detection solution to cope with evolving cybersecurity threats.

articleTitle: Dynamic Point Convolution-Based Point Cloud Completion Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Point cloud completion, a method that infers the complete point cloud by extracting features from a partial point cloud, is a crucial issue in 3D visual research. Currently, deep learning techniques have been widely applied in this field. However, most typical deep learning point cloud completion networks focus on the completion of the overall shape of the point cloud rather than the repair of local details. In light of this, this study proposes a novel dynamic point convolution-based point cloud completion network. This network uses a dual-branch encoder to extract spatial features and structural features from the point cloud and merge these two features. Subsequently, a multi-layer perceptron is used to generate a coarse completion of the partial point cloud, and finally, a dense completion point cloud is generated by grid folding. The experimental results show that the proposed point cloud completion network outperforms PCN and other point cloud completion networks. In terms of CDL1, CD-L2, and EMD metrics, the proposed network reduces 6.67%, 18.53%, and 4.53% on average, respectively, and in terms of F-Score metric, the proposed network outperforms the PCN by 2.41 percentage points on average.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm for Detecting Small Target Fittings on Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Targeting the problem of a small number of pixels of small targets and lack of effective feature information, difficult background differentiation, and sensitivity to localization offset in the task of transmission line small target fittings detection, this paper proposes an algorithm for transmission line small target fittings detection, which is noted as SCCN-YOLO. Based on YOLOv8, this paper firstly adds a small target detection layer, which enhances the fusion effect of the small target features; secondly, it uses the CARAFE upsampling operator in the backbone network to expand the sensory field of the upsampled features, improving the network's ability to extract small target features, capturing semantic information, and reducing information loss are enhanced by this approach; Then the CBAM attention mechanism is introduced to focus on the target features to inhibit the interference of irrelevant information and to enhance the small target features; Finally, the NWD loss function is used to reduce the sensitivity of the loss function to the target localization bias and to improve the network's ability to detect. The experimental results prove that the accuracy of the algorithm proposed in this paper reaches 87.9%, and it can effectively detect the small target fittings of transmission Lines.

articleTitle: Construction of Deep Learning Air Quality Forecasting System with Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming to address the issues of low prediction accuracy, artificial experience assistance, and single scope of application in existing air quality forecasting systems, we first design an air quality forecasting system by using the deep learning methods in analyzing the intrinsic characteristics of data and combining multi-source data fusion technology. Then, the key technologies, e.g., real-time production and update of multisource data sets, analysis of spatial-temporal characteristics of air quality evolution, definition and fitting of deep learning model and deployment in servers, are investigated. Finally, multi-scale and high-precision real-time forecast service and visualization of forecast results of air quality are realized. The experiment results show that compared to the long short-term memory(LSTM) and Transformer models used for daily forecasting, the root mean squared error(RMSE) of the proposed Convolutional Neural Network-Transformer (CNN-Transformer) model decreased by 14% and 12%, respectively, and the mean absolute error(MAE) decreased by 17% and 15.8%, respectively.

articleTitle: Micro Monitor for Four Physiological Parameters from Fingertip
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Real-time monitoring and timely warning of human physiological parameters is very important and necessary for mastering an individual's health status. This project aims to select fingers with abundant blood vessels as the detection site, gather information on blood and vascular changes through photoelectric and temperature sensors, and extract features to obtain important physiological parameter values such as pulse, heart rate, saturation of peripheral oxygen, and body temperature, achieving the goal of multi-parameter synchronous monitoring. The results showed that the micro monitoring system has good stability and data accuracy with many characteristics such as small size, light weight, low power consumption, and easy portability. It is not only suitable for personal health monitoring, but also suitable for assisting medical workers in diagnosis and decision-making in professional settings. At the same time, it also provides a new approach and technical support for the field of mobile healthcare.

articleTitle: Research on Improved Automatic Driving Target Detection Algorithm for Yolo v5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In automatic driving, its detection scene is different from the simple object detection scene, there are problems such as complex detection background, large change in the size of similar targets, deformation of moving targets and small target detection, so a YOLO V5-based Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) and Squeeze and Excitation Module (SENet) two improved algorithms of attention mechanism, through attention to enhance the ability to learn the specific characteristics of the target, focus attention on the obvious details of the road scene. Experiments show that different optimization strategies can significantly improve the detection accuracy, and also effectively improve the ability of the model in YOLO V5 to pay attention to global information and detect obstructed targets in autonomous driving scenarios.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Complex Real-time Computing based on Data Middle Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the development of big data, the need for realtime data processing becomes more urgent. However, the complexity of the big data business causes the current data components to not be well supported. For this reason, a complex real-time calculation method based on data center is proposed. Build incremental dimension tables and incremental fact tables based on the original micro-batch scheduling, and analyze the impact of business incremental data changes on statistical results. And through the analysis of business operations, simplify the data processing process, reduce the data Merge operation, and reduce the data processing time. Finally, the feasibility, correctness and real-time nature of the method are verified through the application of real-time calculation of electricity bills.

articleTitle: Adaptive Backward-link Resource Allocation in Beam Hopping Communication System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Satellite communication plays a crucial role in the world due to its global coverage, flexibility, and reliability. As one of the key technologies, beam hopping technology can effectively improve the available capacity of the system and enhance the flexibility of satellite resource scheduling. However, most of the research on resource allocation technology for beam hopping satellites primarily focused on the theoretical level which presents challenges such as high algorithm complexity and low real-time performance. Therefore, further research is necessary to explore practical applications. In this paper, based on the actual satellite communication scenario, the model of the bouncing beam satellite communication system is analyzed first. Then, based on the DVBRCS2 protocol standard, we propose a backward-link scheduling algorithm that supports channel state adaptation. Finally, two calculation schemes of resource allocation are designed to match different traffic requirements. Simulation results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the proposed method can meet the system capacity with lower algorithm complexity. Moreover, it successfully meets various service requirements and holds significant engineering implications.

articleTitle: A PSO-BP Target Localization Accuracy Enhancement Method for Airborne Optoelectronic Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study aims to address the issue of target positioning accuracy in airborne optoelectronic platforms. Firstly, the paper refines and summarizes the typical workflow for target positioning based on UAV airborne optoelectronic platforms. To enhance the target positioning accuracy of airborne optoelectronic platforms, an improved method based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm (PSO) and the backpropagation neural network (BP) is proposed. The paper begins by explaining the research background and identifying the problems. It then proposes a target localization model based on the optoelectronic platform. Subsequently, the PSO-BP method is introduced, highlighting its advantages, principles, and implementation process. Experimental results demonstrate that the PSO-BP method can effectively enhance the target localization accuracy of airborne optoelectronic platforms. The research findings of this paper hold significant theoretical importance and practical value in improving the target localization accuracy of airborne optoelectronic platforms. Additionally, they offer a new research direction for further advancements in UAV target localization. In conclusion, this comprehensive literature review provides insights into the research gap and research motivation in the field of target positioning accuracy in airborne optoelectronic platforms. The proposed PSO-BP method demonstrates its effectiveness in enhancing target localization accuracy. The findings contribute to the theoretical understanding and practical application of improving target localization in airborne optoelectronic platforms, and they also suggest avenues for future research in UAV target localization.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Recognition Method of Glass Screen Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: At present, the glass screen defects recognition mos tly rely on manual detection, eye long time will lead to visual fatig ue, thus affecting the accuracy of the glass screen defect detection and recognition of the time used for each piece of glass screen. T his paper proposes a machine vision-based glass defect detection method, for the glass screen scratches defective features are often presented inconspicuously, resulting in faulty detection, omission detection of the situation, using the detection process of two angl es of light with the left side of the light and 45 ° oblique angle of t he light, to solve the weak scratches presented inconspicuous pro blem. Data preprocessing is performed using grayscaling and ima ge differencing to remove redundant information. The algorithm uses the Yolov8 neural network, which is made more suitable for industrial machine environments by thinning the network and usi ng slim-neck to reduce the amount of Yolov8 network computatio n. The attention mechanism Triplet Attention is added after the S PPF module of the backbone network to ensure good detection. T he improved network weight file size drops by 11.3%, mAP0.5 ris es by 1.4%, and the detection speed is 13.2ms, which effectively re places manual labor to achieve fast and effective defect detection.

articleTitle: Pose Adjustmet Method of Multiple Structured Light Sensors for Complex Profile Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Line structured light sensors are widely used in 3D measurement. To obtain completed results of complex profiles, the measurement system usually needs multiple sensors. Due to the misalignment of the laser plane, the measurement accuracy of overlapped profile is hard to be guaranteed. Therefore, a laser plane pose adjustment method based on 3D target is proposed. Firstly, the laser plane is obtained by fitting the test points whose coordinate values are computed by use of the invariance of cross-ratio principle. After obtaining the coefficient of the corresponding laser plane, the normal vector and the pose of the laser plane can be obtained. In the same world coordinate system, the average distance between measurement points and the fitted laser plane can also be calculated. Whether the laser planes are coplanar can be judged by their included angles and the point-to-plane distances of measured profiles. With these evaluation parameters, the pose of the laser line projector can be adjusted. Finally, the cross section profile of a cuboid and rail is measured. By comparing with the reference value, significant improvement of measurement accuracy can be achieved.

articleTitle: Small object detection algorithm for aerial photography based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems such as high missed detection rate and inaccurate positioning caused by complex background, large number and dense distribution of small targets in UAV aerial photography target detection tasks, this paper proposed an improved YOLOv5 based aerial small target detection model. Firstly, the reparameterized structure RepVGG is introduced into the backbone network, and the multi-branch structure is used to enhance the feature extraction capability of the model. Secondly, a hybrid domain Attention mechanism (ECA DSAM Model, EDM), Efficient Channel Attention mechanism (ECA) and Dilated Spatial attention Model (Dilated Spatial Attention Model) are designed. EDM). Experiments on UAV aerial photography data set VisDrone show that m AP0.5 of the original YOLOv5 model has improved by 2.7%, and the improved method has better performance in the detection of small targets in aerial photography.

articleTitle: A Long-term Traffic Flow Prediction Model Based on Multiple Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming to solve the problem of low prediction performance in long-term traffic flow prediction, we suggest a new forecasting method called Multiple Feature Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks (MF-TGCN). In long-term traffic flow prediction, some characteristics beyond road conditions can also become the main factors affecting traffic flow changes. In this article, we take into account factors such as weather, temperature, and holidays in road network traffic, extract spatial features of traffic information through Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN), and extract temporal features of traffic information through Gate Recurrent Unit(GRU). At the same time, to improve the prediction accuracy of the model, we used a threshold Gaussian kernel to calculate the weight of roads between adjacent stations. On the basis of real traffic flow information, the results show that the MF-TGCN model performence better than other current prediction model.

articleTitle: An Advanced Real-Time Semantic Segmentation Algorithm for Water Level Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: For achieving automated water level detection based on image recognition, emphasizing precision and real-time capability, we introduce a water level detection algorithm founded on real-time semantic segmentation. Firstly, we introduce a shared feature extraction layer to effectively reduce channel and parameter redundancy in the BiSeNetV2 network. Subsequently, the feature extraction backbone is redesigned using partial convolution and FasterNet block, to achieve a balance between precision and inference speed. Additionally, we introduce an auxiliary edge loss function to improve the precision of water gauge segmentation edges. We achieved an mIoU of 97.3% at 132.9 FPS on the water gauge dataset, with a water level reading error of less than 1 cm under practical measurement conditions. Compared to other real-time semantic segmentation algorithms, our approach achieves an excellent balance between precision and real-time performance. Our method has been implemented at hydrological stations in two other regions and continues to maintain high accuracy in practical applications, demonstrating its robustness and generalization.

articleTitle: Research on CNN Fusion Processing Technology for GNSS/INS Special Area Navigation Application
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, users have put forward high requirements for the positioning accuracy and stability of navigation and positioning systems. In special domain environments such as valleys, viaducts, tunnels, etc., the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signal is susceptible to external interference, resulting in a decrease in positioning accuracy, and the positioning error of the Inertial Navigation System (INS) will accumulate over time. Therefore, this paper studies the vehicle navigation system of GNSS/INS integrated positioning and proposes a new algorithm model to solve the accuracy problem of the non-integrity constraint model in measuring the lateral and normal velocity of the carrier. The algorithm simulates zero-mean Gaussian white noise by dynamically adjusting the model and uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) to optimize the covariance of pseudomeasurement noise with non-integrity constraints, to achieve the optimal fusion of the Kalman Filter (KF) model. Through the analysis and comparison of positioning accuracy and error, the convolutional neural network-integrated navigation (CNNGNSS/INS) data fusion processing model is finally determined.

articleTitle: Research on Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing for Wireless Communication Based on Multi-Mode Vortex Electromagnetic Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the continuous development of mobile communication, the wireless communication industry has achieved good development. However, in the actual transmission of multi-mode vortex electromagnetic waves, there are problems such as multipath fading, frequency fading, delay fading and polarization, which seriously affect the quality of wireless communication. The emergence and application of orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) technology can fundamentally solve the above problems. Therefore, this paper takes the application of “OFDM technology” as an example to build a powerful and practical Angel broadband wireless access system to improve the propagation quality of multi-mode vortex electromagnetic waves. Firstly, based on the analysis results of multi-mode vortex electromagnetic wave propagation, the principle of OFDM technology and the key technologies of OFDM system are introduced. Secondly, from the aspects of system and function design, system model design, system performance index design, system application effect, etc., the design and application of Angel broadband wireless access system are completed. The results show that Angel broadband wireless access system runs normally, reliably and stably, and the realization of each function module meets the design requirements and meets the practical application requirements. It is hoped that this study can provide effective reference for relevant practitioners.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of A Multi-Core CPU Compilation Optimization Framework Based on MLIR
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Most on-board software is developed and adapted around traditional hardware resources. When high-performance hardware is introduced to the on-board heterogeneous computing platform, on-board software cannot fully leverage the processing capabilities of the high-performance hardware, making it difficult to meet the real-time requirements of multiple application tasks. For signal processing algorithms and other non-matrix complex scientific computing tasks to be arranged and adapted on multi-core CPUs, traditional algorithms are mainly developed based on DSP processors, making it difficult to directly deploy them on multi-core CPU processors. This article proposes and constructs a MLIR-based multi-core CPU compilation optimization framework, designs an automatic software code execution optimization process, achieves full adaptation of on-board software on multi-core CPU resources, improves the processing efficiency of complex scientific computing tasks, and solves the problem of poor real-time performance of complex scientific computing tasks. Compared with the two types of compilation optimization systems currently in use, the average speedup ratio was 7.54 and 3.26 times, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Division MIMO Radar Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Among the main implementation forms of MIMO radar, only frequency division MIMO radar can meet the real-time imaging requirements under ultra wideband conditions. The miniaturization is currently an important direction for its development. Additionally, most real-time performance is difficult to guarantee in traditional processing flow of frequency division MIMO radar. This paper proposes an integrated machine for frequency division MIMO radar that integrates transmitter, receiver, signal processing, imaging, and display. The frequency division MIMO of this new system utilizes multiple transmitting antennas to simultaneously transmit sweep signals at certain frequency intervals, achieving frequency orthogonality. By using multiple receiving antennas to simultaneously receive the scattered waveform of the target, a single snapshot can be achieved under ultra wideband conditions. The system utilizes multiple transmitting antennas to simultaneously transmit sweep signals with frequency increments, achieving frequency orthogonality. Multiple receiving antennas simultaneously receive scattered waveforms of targets, which can obtain target information through a single snapshot, greatly reducing the time required to obtain data.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient and Low-Loss Thermo-Optic Phase Shifter Enabled by Inverse Design
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Photonic integrated chips offer great potential for applications in data centers, sensors, optical computing etc, due to large data transmission capacity, rapid transmission rate and CMOS compatibility. On-chip optical transmission mainly involves optical interference, and it puts certain requirements on the optical phase. Metal based thermo-optic phase shifters are often oversized and provide a slow response. In order to achieve tradeoff between energy consumption, optical loss, footprint and thermal crosstalk, we present an thermo-optic phase shifter based on a standard SOI platform by inverse design. The thermooptic phase shifter is engineered based on an N-doped heater. In the design process, enhanced particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the device performance. Simulation results show that the phase shifter exhibits a significant phase shift efficiency of 20.6 mW/π. In addition, a compact heater length of 72 μm and a low insertion loss of <0.0026 dB are achieved. With a favorable tradeoff of multiple performance metrics, the thermooptic phase shifter can be widely used in high-density photonic systems.

articleTitle: A Low Power Wake-Up Receiver Design Based on Commercial Off-the-shelf Components
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To reduce the power consumption of wireless sensor network terminal nodes, researchers have attempted to integrate wake-up receiver modules into the nodes. Existing studies often design wake-up receivers in the form of chips, which can be costly. Furthermore, wake-up receiver chips are not readily available in the market. Therefore, we propose a design solution for a wake-up receiver based on off-the-shelf components and have implemented a prototype receiver.
