The cost of our proposed receiver is ∃5, with a power consumption of 9uW at a data rate of 5 kbps. It can be implemented using off-the-shelf components and incorporates a mechanism to prevent false wake-ups, meeting the requirements of general application scenarios.

articleTitle: SSVEP Brain-Computer Interface Decoding Based on Spatio-temporal TRCA Filtering and Least Squares Data Migration
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Due to its high stability and information transfer rate, steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) is one of the most widely used brain-computer interface paradigms. However, because of inter-subject variability, SSVEP BCI decoding algorithms still require to be calibrated with a substantial amount of training data before practical application. This study integrates both temporal and spatial filters into the task-related component analysis algorithm to obtain more stable template signals. Additionally, transfer learning is employed to incorporate cross-subject data into the training process, reducing the number of training samples and improving the performance of SSVEP decoding algorithms. where the source domain data is migrated to the target domain using a least squares transform approach. The proposed algorithm is validated on public dataset and results show that, compared to the pure TRCA, the proposed stTRCA-LST algorithm can improve the recognition accuracy by 8.73%. The new algorithm is easy to conduct and can further simplify the calibration effort in practical application of SSVEP-based BCls.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Test System for System Chip Function Test
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of system-onchip (SOC) functional testing (FT) and mass production testing and improve the performance of the testing system, this paper designed an SOC FT multi-site testing system based on Chroma 3380D (Tester) and FPGA. This paper is mainly introduced from the overall structure of the system, testing process, hardware and software design of the system, and put forward the innovation points of the system. Finally, some HD video decoding SOCs were tested with this system. According to the test results, the system has reached the stable FT mass production multi-site test requirements and has the ability of mass production test in the factory.

articleTitle: LEO Satellite Network Traffic Forecasting based on ARIMA-BPNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Satellite network traffic forecasting provides key information for routing and resource allocation, which is important for the efficient operation of satellite network. However, due to the self-similarity and long-range dependence (LRD) of satellite network traffic, traditional linear or non-linear network traffic forecasting models cannot achieve sufficient forecasting accuracy. A combined model of satellite network traffic forecasting based on BPNN and ARIMA is proposed. BPNN is adopted to forecast the residuals. EMD-ARIMA and BPNN forecasting results are combined to achieve satellite network traffic forecasting. Experimental results on the satellite network traffic data generated by the ON/OFF model show that forecast accuracy of the proposed method is better than traditional model, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed satellite network traffic forecast model.

articleTitle: Underwater target tracking algorithm based on nonlinear RTS smoothing SVD-UKF with adaptive coefficients
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To address the accuracy and stability issues in underwater target tracking, it is essential to consider the impact of nonlinear state as well as measurement equations on filtering performance, as well as the potential adverse effects of noise and other interfering factors that can render the covariance matrix coefficients non-positive-definite. In this study, we use the Singular Value Decomposition-based Unscented Kalman Filter (SVD-UKF), along with the application of Rauch-Tung-Striebel (RTS) smoothing for tracking the target's position. Three filtering algorithms are evaluated for their tracking performance through simulated analysis: the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF), SVD-UKF, and RTS-UKF. The results indicate that, in the presence of nonlinear state and measurement equations, applying RTS smoothing with coefficient adjustments and utilizing SVD-UKF leads to higher filtering accuracy in both position and velocity estimation. The improved algorithm exhibits a 40% reduction in the Root Mean Square Error of position compared to the standard UKF. Furthermore, the filtered tracking trajectory demonstrates enhanced stability.

articleTitle: A 20μm Pixel-pitch, 60Me- DROIC Based on CTIA for 640 x 512 Infrared Focal Plane Array
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, a 20μm pixel-pitch, 60Me- charge handling capacity digital readout circuit (DROIC) based on capacitor feedback transimpedance amplifier (CTIA) for 640 x 512 infrared focal plane array (IRFPA) is presented. Compared to the direct injection (DI) structure, the CTIA structure is adopted, which offers higher injection efficiency and is not influenced by background light, thus achieving higher linearity. Furthermore, a two-stage quantization approach is employed to enhance the charge handling capacity compared to the traditional structure based on pulse frequency modulation (PFM). Considering the pixel size, the coarse quantization produces a 4-bit signal, while for fine quantization, a 12-bit digital signal is generated by four column-shared analog preprocessing circuit (APC) and a 12-bit successive approximation register (SAR) ADC. Based on the 0.18μm 1P6M process, the simulation results indicate that the nonlinearity of DROIC is 99.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the pixel array power consumption is 233mW, and the dynamic range (DR) is 95.6dB.

articleTitle: A Geohash-Based Location-Aware Computing Resource Sharing System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This article presents an innovative Geohash-based system for location-aware computing resource sharing, focused on AIOT. The system utilizes Geohash code, embedding device information, IP addresses, port numbers, and computing resources. Through broadcast interactions, devices exchange geographic and resource data, facilitating rapid access to nearby computing resources for distributed processing and enhanced efficiency.

articleTitle: Oil Spill Detection on Sea Surface Based on SAR-Images by Using Global Context and Edge Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) has been widely used in marine environmental monitoring. However, there are some challenges in the detection of oil spills based on SAR images. Existing oil spill detection methods inadequately consider the characteristics of SAR images, such as high noise, complex texture, and blurry boundaries, resulting in poor edge accuracy and false positives and negatives in oil spill region detection. In response to these issues, this paper proposes a sea surface oil spill detection model based on global context and edge awareness. Firstly, the model enhances the extraction and utilization of edge information by designing an edge-aware detection branch network. Secondly, improvements are made to the feature extraction method of the encoder. The backbone network is enhanced for capturing low-level feature information of oil spills by introducing the CA (Channel Attention) module. The use of a dense-connected spatial pyramid module expands the receptive field to enhance global context awareness, thereby improving the extraction of high-level semantic features from oil spill features. Finally, through comparative experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed detection model in this chapter is validated.

articleTitle: Design of Bandgap Voltage Reference Circuit with High-PSR and High-Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to reduce the influence of power supply voltage fluctuation on the secondary voltage control loop in the switching power supply, high-PSR, and high-precision bandgap reference was designed. In this design, the bias module uses a positive feedback circuit to improve the circuit start-up speed, and the reference voltage is designed to improve the power supply rejection ratio of the circuit by combining a bias circuit with a negative feedback form. The circuit was designed based on the 0.18μm 30V BCD process, and the design was simulated and verified by Cadence Virtuoso software. Under a 5V power supply, the reference temperature coefficient is 20.7ppm/°C, and the power supply rejection ratio is −110dB below 100Hz. The results show that the design of this paper conforms to the application environment of the secondary control loop.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Distance Measurement With FMCW Radar and Phase Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The main focus of this paper is on an indoor positioning system based on high-precision ranging. Firstly, a high-precision algorithm based on phase was studied and compared with other related algorithms. After simulation, hardware experiments were conducted to demonstrate the feasibility of achieving precise positioning for a certain object.

articleTitle: Identifying most influential nodes in multilayer networks under tensorial framework
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: How heterogeneous connectivity determines dynamical processes and control strategies on complex systems is a core problem in network science. While a vast majority of studies focus on dynamical systems and control theory for single-layer networks, this paper is dedicated to investigating multilayer networks based on a tensorial framework. In this study, a control strategy on multilayer networks is proposed for selecting controlled node-layer tuples which can maximise the convergence rate of the dynamical process of consensus on general multilayer networks in cases of sufficiently small controlling strength. Mathematical derivation, including matricisation and perturbation methods, demonstrates that this optimal selection strategy follows the ranking of node-layer tuples according to a novel multilayer centrality measure called the Left Eigentensor Index (LEtI). Numerical simulations also support our theoretical result.

articleTitle: Analysis of Relay Protection Fault Propagation Mechanism and Attack Detection Method Under Cyber Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the continuous development of new power system, the innovative application of information and communication technology not only promotes the intelligent evolution of power grid, but also attracts much attention on its network security. As the first line of defense of power system, relay protection device is widely used in power system. However, in the digital communication scene of smart substation, hackers can take advantage of the loopholes in the communication protocol of smart substation to tamper with the protection setting value, switch the setting value area, and throw back the soft board, which will affect the correct action of the protection device, lead to misoperation or refusal of protection, and affect the safe and stable operation of power system. In this paper, the fault propagation mechanism of relay protection under cyber attack is analyzed and studied, and the cyber attack detection method for protection devices is studied, which provides technical reference for improving the network security protection ability of relay protection business in power system.

articleTitle: Research on Gesture Recognition Method Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence and the update of human-computer interaction mode, the research of visual recognition methods based on deep learning has become an important research direction at present, which can have better robustness while maintaining a good detection effect compared with the traditional gesture recognition method. In this paper, we mainly study the gesture recognition method based on deep learning, and its main contents are as follows:(1) For model training, five kinds of gesture images from the HaGRID gesture dataset, a total of 3100 images, are selected, and then the gestures are annotated by Make Sense software, to obtain the homemade dataset. (2) The deep learning model YOLOv5 is used for the study of gesture recognition and the YOLOv5 model is improved. Firstly, the spatial pyramid pooling structure SPPF in the YOLOv5 algorithm is changed to SPPCSPC, and a maximum pooling kernel of size 3×3 is added to the SPPCSPC structure, secondly, to improve the detection accuracy of the gesture, the CBAM attention mechanism is embedded in Backbone's C3, which focuses the model's attention on the gesture. Finally, it is experimentally verified that the average precision mAP of the improved gesture recognition method has an overall improvement of 1.8% compared to the pre-improvement period.

articleTitle: The Deep Neural Network Compilers for FPGAs: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In embedded systems, the low-latency, low-power consumption, and reconfigurable FPGA component undertakes the inference operations of a large number of computationally intensive tasks, such as artificial intelligence algorithms, making the deep neural network compiler for FPGAs a hot topic. This FPGA compiler can automatically optimize the model calculation diagrams and hardware structure design, and can achieve the end-to-end deployment of neural network models, efficiently and rapidly. This paper summarizes the general framework structure of the neural network compiler for FPGAs, focuses on the development of three representative compilers, compares the deployment performance of specific algorithms on the FPGA platform, summarizes the development advantages and limitations, and finally proposes its application prospects and important research directions in embedded systems, providing a theoretical basis for the rapid iteration and deployment of artificial intelligence algorithms in embedded computing systems.

articleTitle: A Panic Recognition Model Based on Face Alignment and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Accurate identification of panic among individuals is a challenging but valuable application in the rapidly growing field of emotion recognition, particularly in the public security and healthcare industries. To recognize the panic emotion in a pedestrian crowd, this study introduces a facial expression recognition network (FER-net) as an advanced deep-learning network aimed at recognizing panic states. Then a panic recognition model based on face alignment (FA) and convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed. This model can obtain greater accuracy in detecting minor emotions indicating panic by maintaining the ideal alignment of facial features. To validate this proposed model, experiments were designed. The experiment results showed a significant increase in panic detection rates compared with conventional models, and the possibility of the FER-net as a reliable tool for use in reality. Finally, this study emphasizes the positive effects of using face alignment with CNNs and can be taken as a new emotion detection technique that concentrate on unpleasant feelings like panic emotion.

articleTitle: Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems Based Frequency Reconfigurable Butterfly Slit-Coupled Microstrip-Fed Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To suit the requirements of various wireless system s for antennas with different operating frequencies, this article pr oposes a novel type MEMS frequency reconfigurable slit-coupled microstrip-fed antennas, which adds two metal sheets connecting combs arround the slit. By electrostatically actuating the comb te eth to drive the movement of metal sheets, to change the width of the slit ultimately affects the slit between the microstrip feeder an d the patch antenna. This antenna adopts butterfly slit coupling t o increase slit variation and achieve a larger adjustable frequency range. The comb teeth on two flanks drive two metal sheets to mo ve away from the microstrip feeder in a horizontal direction perp endicular to it. The resonant frequency of the antenna shifts to th e left. When the displacement of the metal sheets is 10um, the ante nna can achieve an adjustable resonant frequency in the 1.18GHz range. The simulation results show that the variation of antenna frequency within this range is monotonic, indicating that the ante nna can effectively achieve frequency reconfigurability. The articl e uses HFSS and ANSYS to simulate the RF and mechanical perf ormance of the antenna and verify its reliability. This antenna ac hieves high frequency reconfigurability with small displacement, providing a theoretical model for the design of smart antennas.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Channel Data Transmission System Based on PCIe-SRIO
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to meet the long-distance and high-reliable transmission needs of multi- channel data, a multi-channel data transmission system based on PCIE-SRIO is designed. The Xilinx K7 series FPGA chip is designed, and the internal integrated PCIe and SRIO IP cores are used, and then the optical cable is connected to the optical cable to achieve long -range data sending and receiving. The system is based on the PCIe bus to realize the interconnection between the CPU chip and the FPGA chip, and the FPGA actively initiates and terminates the DMA transmission method to realize the high-speed interaction of multiple channels of data between the CPU chip and the FPGA chip. The internal logic of FPGA realizes SRIO interface based on HELLO packet format, and the sender uses Round-Robin arbitration mechanism to design multi-interface, which realizes the com-petition processing when multi-channel interfaces share a SRIO interface to send data at the same time. The results show that the designed system can realize data sending and receiving under 8 channels at most, which has certain reference significance for the application of long-distance transmission of interconnected data between boards.

articleTitle: Magnetic resonance image reconstruction based on two-stage progressive network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In clinical applications, medical image reconstruction is crucial for extracting complementary information and restoring image quality. However, existing deep learning-based reconstruction methods suffer from the following two problems: first, they ignore the frequency-domain information specific to magnetic resonance imaging, and second, most of the traditional networks are single-end-to-end networks, which lack effective attention to feature information. We suggest a unique two-stage progressive network (TSPNet) to solve these issues. Our approach employs two lightweight Unets as subnetworks for progressive recovery, and the network parts are carefully designed. During the feature extraction phase, we creatively create a Dual Domain Feature Extraction Module (DDFEM) to effectively extract rich features. Subsequently, we create a hybrid attention module (HAM) to effectively process and integrate the retrieved data. Experimental results show that our model outperforms other state-of-the-art methods and reconstructs images with stronger texture information and superior visual quality.

articleTitle: Research on Gap Waveguide Millimeter Wave Array Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A single-layer, wideband, low-loss feed network for slot antenna arrays is described. The antenna is fabricated using ridged waveguide technology and is formed between two parallel metal plates, eliminating the need for electrical contact between these plates. The feed network is implemented by means of a pin texture and guide ridge on the base plate, with radiating slots placed on a smooth top plate. This article innovatively proposes a ridge slot waveguide antenna array installed on a cylindrical ground plane, which is fed by a quarter power splitter to 40 time slots out of 4 branches. The full wave simulation of the antenna structure was conducted using CST microwave studio, and the characteristics of the ridge gap waveguide antenna array were studied through simulation. The impedance bandwidth of the array was 5GHz, and the gain of the linear array was 11.2 dBi.

articleTitle: Temperature Prediction for Ultra-Low Temperature Measurement System Based on Improved Extreme Learning Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Temperature monitoring is essential to ensure the operational safety of fusion devices in the ultra-low temperature liquid helium region. However, the unavoidable errors caused by environmental effects severely hinder the accuracy of its temperature measurement. Considering that traditional methods are not accurate enough to predict the temperature at low temperatures, for the first time, this work proposes an algorithm based on the SSA-PSO-ELM network for constructing a prediction model of the cryogenic measurement system. By this method, the initial number of hidden layer nodes is first randomly generated, then the network is trained with weight thresholds, and finally a quadratic optimization search is performed to determine the best network prediction model. Compared with the traditional algorithm, our algorithm effectively reduces the prediction error, improve the accuracy, and realize more accurate temperature monitoring in ultra-low temperature environment.

articleTitle: Long-Term Maintenance Plan for the Aero-Engine Fleet Under Uncertain Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aero-engine fleet long-term maintenance plan has been one of the important means for airlines to reduce the operation and maintenance cost of the whole fleet and realize the balance of engine delivery and repair. This paper improves the aero-engine fleet long-term maintenance plan under deterministic conditions, proposes an optimization method for aero-engine fleet long-term plan under uncertain conditions, and solves the problem that aero-engine fleet long-term plan under deterministic conditions is difficult to be applied in practical situations. After establishing the optimization model, the IBI (Incomprehensible but Intelligible-in-time logics) solution model is used to improve the efficiency of solving the optimal value, and reduce the total number of missing days and the total number of wasted days. Sixteen sets of comparative tests verified that the fleet maintenance schedule model under the uncertainty condition outperformed the deterministic condition in terms of the number of missing days and the number of wasted days. The absolute errors of the optimal values and equilibrium indices solved under the uncertainty condition were within acceptable limits.

articleTitle: Sphere Decoding for Multiset Codes in Noisy Permutation Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Motivated by DNA-based storage systems, this paper examines the decoding problems for the multiset codes in the noisy permutation channels, which permute the transmitted symbols randomly and impose noise such as symbol insertions, deletions and substitutions on symbols. The connection between multiset codes and the maximum/maximal independent sets is established. Based on this connection, a sphere decoding algorithm specifically designed for multiset codes is proposed to reduce the time complexity of decoding while guaranteeing the equivalent codeword error rate to that of ML decoding.

articleTitle: Study on the Modeling of a Neuromorphic Transistor Circuit System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: When the traditional von Neumann architecture calculates large and complex problems, the data transmission rate and energy consumption between CPU and memory become a huge bottleneck, and the application of neuromorphic computing can effectively solve this problem. In this work, because the neuromorphic computing circuit is composed of neurons and synapses, we mainly achieved the basic functions of neurons and synapses through circuits, and further complete the circuit design and simulation of neuromorphic system. Besides, in the design of the neuron circuit, we innovatively proposed the monostable trigger and pulse emission circuit, which can emit the required pulse waveform, simulate the integrated emission function of biological neurons, and solve the problem of controlling the time length of the pulse emission waveform. Besides, In neural synaptic circuits, we produce approximately linear changes in synaptic weights that enable the function of learning, computation, and forgetting. In summary, using the circuit designed in this paper can improve the learning rate and improve the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Communication Protocol for Global Mainstream Soil Moisture Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This article focuses on the demand for sensor access in the sensing layer of the agricultural IOT. 12 soil moisture sensors from China, the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, and Australia were selected, with the aim of directly connecting the sensors to the IOT. A comparative study was conducted on their communication interfaces and protocols. The 12 selected soil moisture sensors can be divided into three categories based on interface types: analog interface, SDI-12 interface, and RS485 interface. We conducted signal acquisition and communication protocol research on these three types of interfaces, and using the STM32 microcontroller as the platform, the data collection and conversion of these three interface sensors were programmed according to their respective communication protocols, and corresponding soil moisture data was obtained. Research has found that Modbus protocol is the simplest and most straightforward. SDI-12 protocol is second in complexity. Analog interfaces, rely on the calibration formula provided by the manufacturer or require self calibration for their measurement data accuracy.

articleTitle: Event-driven coverage optimization strategy based on VF-SCSO algorithm in underwater wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In marine search and rescue applications, Event-driven networks are capable of monitoring and capturing events as they occur in real time. In this paper, an event-driven coverage optimization strategy based on the virtual force-aided sand cat swarm optimization algorithm (VF-SCSO) is proposed for node deployment in 3D underwater networks. First, the SCSO algorithm was used to initially improve the location of the sensor nodes. Second, the uncovered events and the virtual force of neighboring nodes are introduced to address the coverage vulnerability in the monitoring area. The range of random wandering of the sand cat is limited and the location update of the node is locally adjusted so as to maximize the network coverage. Simulation results show that under the same initial conditions, the VF-SCSO algorithm not only achieves high coverage of target events, but also greatly reduces the moving distance of nodes during the deployment process, achieving the purpose of reducing energy consumption.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Current Sensing Circuit With Built-In Offset Self-Zeroing Operational Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To solve the problem that the load current sensing precision of transistor power switch chip was easily affected by the offset voltage of operational amplifier(op-amp), current sensing mode, process and environmental change, a highprecision current sensing circuit was designed. The sensing transistors was used to sense the load current in equal proportion, and the sensing precision was high. The design of the auto-zero amplifier could reduce the offset voltage caused by the process fabricating of the operational amplifier, and then increased the loop gain, improved the precision of the circuit current sensing. The circuit was fabricated with a 40V 0.35 µm BCD process. Simulation results show that the average offset voltage of the operational amplifier in the sensing circuit is about 1µV under the condition of 27°C temperature and 13V supply power. With load current ranging from 50mA ཞ 4.5A, the current sensing precision can achieve 99.88%. In the temperature range of −40°Cཞ150°C, the offset error is not more than 2%, and the sensing precision error is not more than 0.74%.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Study of Nuclear Power Plant Electronic Systems Based on Machine Learning Optimization Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In modern society, the rapid development of information technology makes a variety of electronic devices are widely used, and the electronic systems in these devices are often the key to the control system, and their stability and security are crucial to the operation of the whole system. This paper studies and compares the prediction ability of various machine learning algorithm models in the intrusion detection of electronic systems in nuclear power plants. The results show that the decision tree model and random forest model have the best prediction ability, which is far better than the other models. The linear regression model and KNN model have poor prediction ability, while the BP neural network model has poor prediction effect and is not suitable for intrusion detection of nuclear power plant electronic system. Intrusion detection in electronic systems of nuclear power plants is an important security problem, so it is important to study the prediction ability of different machine learning models for this problem. In this paper, through the experimental comparison of multiple machine learning models, we found that the decision tree model and random forest model have the best prediction ability, which indicates that these two models have high prediction ability and accuracy in nuclear power plant electronic system intrusion detection. The linear regression model and KNN model have poorer predictive ability, which may be due to the inability of these two models to capture the complex relationships in the intrusion detection of nuclear power plant electronic systems. And the BP neural network model has poor predictive effect, which may be due to the fact that the model is prone to overfitting phenomenon, resulting in inaccurate prediction results. The findings of this paper show that these conclusions provide valuable references for intrusion detection in electronic systems of nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Electricity consumption prediction based on Transformer-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The prediction of electricity consumption in the power system has always been an important task in the management of the power department. Propose a regional electricity consumption prediction model based on the combination of Transformer and Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTM). Firstly, the time dimension of the data is split and combined with other features as data features for electricity consumption prediction. Then, the input data is first passed through the Transformer encoding layer, then through the LSTM layer, and finally output is obtained through the linear layer. At the same time, a residual connection was added to concatenate the output and input features of the LSTM layer and input them into the linear layer. The experimental results show that the Transformer LSTM based prediction method exhibits excellent performance in predicting regional electricity consumption, providing a feasible and effective solution for managers when analyzing electricity consumption.

Author Keywords: Long and Short Term Memory Network

articleTitle: Electric Load Forecasting with Fast Fourier Transform-Optimized Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Electric load forecasting, a crucial support function for power system planning, faces increasing complexity with the deepening of electricity market reforms and the emergence of new technologies and roles like the sharing economy, load aggregators, and virtual power plants. These developments introduce new characteristics to electric loads, posing significant challenges to predictive modeling. Traditional load forecasting methods, primarily reliant on statistical analysis or expert models, struggle to accurately construct load models in this evolving power system environment, owing to the diverse and complex factors influencing loads. To address this challenge, in the paper, we proposed a novel electric load forecasting model based on Fast Fourier Transform-optimized (FFT) Transformer model. This model redefines electric load forecasting as a time series problem, empowering it to extract periodic features of electricity usage from data. The model has demonstrated significant effectiveness on an electric load dataset from a specific region, covering over 2,000 power users in three years.

articleTitle: Motor Imagery EEG Recognition Based on Label Alignment and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In the brain-computer interface (BCI) based on motor imagery (MI), the accurate recognition of EEG signals is very important for the successful application of the braincomputer interface (BCI) system. Since EEG signals vary greatly from subject to subject, a model combining label alignment and multi-scale convolutional networks is designed to address this problem: firstly, label alignment can reduce the variability of each type of EEG signals among different subjects, and finally, multiscale convolution is used to fully extract the potential features of EEG signals. The experimental results show that the model has an average classification accuracy of 62.37% on the publicly available BCI Competition IV dataset 2a, which is better than the experimental results of the other five state-of-the-art models, indicating that this model has good decoding performance in motor imagery EEG signal recognition.

articleTitle: A Multi-Domain Dialogue State Tracking Method with Prompt and Graph Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative Multi-Domain Dialogue State Tracking Method with Prompt and Graph Attention Mechanism (DST-PGAM). The focus of this research is on optimizing the prediction of shared values across domain slots by integrating representations from both dialogue and prompts to capture contextual information and semantic relationships. Additionally, the derived representations from the graph attention network are utilized to enhance the GPT-2 model, enabling causal sequence prediction of slot values and explicit modeling of relationships between cross-domain slots and values. Through this approach, precise prediction of domain slot values is achieved, improving the efficiency of the dialogue state tracking module and enabling more accurate analysis of user demands for providing convenient and efficient services. This research provides a new approach to improve the performance and user experience of multi-domain dialog systems.

articleTitle: Automatic Sleep Staging Method Based on Multi-Channel Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Sleep staging is the division and recognition of different stages in the sleep process, which is of great significance for sleep assessment and disease diagnosis. To make manual sleep staging less cumbersome and expensive, many automated schemes have been developed. In this paper, we propose a new approach to sleep staging using the Transformer for the main task, in order to improve the performance of automatic staging. The model converts the original EEG signal, takes the timefrequency images of multiple channels as the model input, and uses the encoder for single-channel feature extraction. The features of each channel are mapped to the feature fusion module (SE, Squeeze and Excitation), and the multi-head attention mechanism replaces LSTM for mining the fusion features. Thus, the prediction performance is improved. The prediction results on the public dataset SleepEDF-20 showed that the average accuracy was achieved 87.3%.

articleTitle: Dynamic-P: A Multi-Beam Directional Antenna MAC Protocol Based on Time Slot States Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Flying ad hoc network (FANET) can be widely used in military or people's livelihood applications because of its flexibility and high efficiency. Multi-beam directional antennas (MBDA) have gradually become a new trend in FANET due to their ability to significantly improve throughput and other performance. Aiming at the defects and shortcomings of traditional media access control (MAC) protocol in MBDA, this paper proposes a dynamic time slot allocation algorithm for MBDA. By introducing the node data volume demand prediction, the time slot state generation probability of the node is adjusted periodically to improve the overall performance of the system. We compare it with the traditional time slot allocation protocol through simulation. The results show that the protocol can significantly improve the communication performance of the system when the system is stable.

articleTitle: An Improved Strength Pareto Evolutionary Algorithm 2 Based on Markov Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As an excellent representative of MOEAs, the strength Pareto evolutionary algorithm 2(SPEA2) becomes an important method for solving MOPs and has been widely applied. However, traditional genetic operators in SPEA2 have strong randomness, which inevitably break the discovered linkage relationship between variables. Therefore, it is more possible for SPEA2 to premature or non-convergence. Fortunately, Markov networks with good linkage learning ability can help SPEA2 improve its performance. This paper presents an improved SPEA2 (MN-SPEA2) by building and sampling Markov network to generate new population. Machine learning in MN-SPEA2 can provide an intelligent search towards global optimal Pareto front. Experimental results also show that MN-SPEA2 has better global convergence than SPEA2.

articleTitle: Diversity Scheme based FSO/RF Hybrid Systems in SAGIN with Interference and Outdated CSI
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Satellite-aerial-ground integrated networks (SAGIN) is an effective means to achieve global seamless coverage and real-time connectivity. In this paper, we investigate the performance of hybrid free-space optical (FSO) and radio frequency (RF) relay systems in SAGIN where the effect of co-channel interference (CCI) and outdated channel station information (CSI) are taken into account. Specifically, we propose different relay strategies considering diversity scheme which are achieved by deploying an additional ground station (GS) and a high-altitude platform (HAP). The FSO link and RF link are modeled by Gamma-Gamma distribution and Nakagami-m distribution, respectively. Then, we derive the cumulative distribution function (CDF) expression of RF link considering CCI and outdated CSI, and the expression of outage probability for our proposed hybrid FSO/RF systems is also given. Comparison scheme is adopted to show the strength of our proposed scheme. Numerical results show that the interference numbers and intensity of can seriously deteriorate system performance, and multiple antennas can further improve system performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Underwater Acoustic Channel Multipath Effects Based on Broadband Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: There are serious multipath effects in the deep-sea acoustic channel, which can have a significant impact on the detection and processing of sonar signals. When both the source and the receiver are located near the sea surface, the receiver receives an arrival signal with a cluster pattern in the time-domain waveform. In this paper, we use the BELLHOP ray acoustic model to simulate the propagation of broadband sources in the deep sea. We differentiate signals arriving in different paths by changing the relative positions of the sources and receivers, and analyze the time-frequency characteristics and spatial-temporal characteristics of the arriving signals. Ultimately, this paper utilizes the arrival signals after separating different paths to estimate the bearing, distance, and depth of the target sound source.

articleTitle: Research on the Applicability of Multi-Source RF Radiation Field Strength Measurement Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to measure the actual field strength of the electromagnetic environment with complex electromagnetic frequency bands, this paper is focused on two measurement methods: electric field probe and antenna. Based on theoretical analysis of their measurement principles, the accuracy of these two methods in measuring actual field strength in multi-source RF electromagnetic environments is compared and experimentally verified. The results indicate that the antenna method can accurately measure the actual field strength within its reliable frequency range, but saturation phenomena may occur due to factors such as its own structure and materials, leading to the measurement results to underestimate the actual value; Diode-type electric field probes can achieve a more accurate estimate of the actual field strength in a low-field-strength environment. Otherwise, they will tend to overestimate the actual field strength. However, thermocouple-type electric field probes are suitable for accurate measurement of the actual field strength of this type of RF field, provided they meet their own sensitivity requirements.

articleTitle: State Observer-based Dynamic Event-triggered Sliding Mode Control For Linear Systems With Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the dynamic event-triggered (DET) integral sliding mode control (SMC) problem in linear systems with disturbances via state observers. Unlike the state event-triggered strategy, a dynamic event-triggered mechanism has been added to reduce communication transmission effectively under the sensor-to-controller channel. To reduce chattering while preserving the rapidly changing sliding variable, an improve DET integral sliding mode controller with a power-reaching law is developed. Both the linear matrix inequalities (LMls) and the Lyapunov stability theory provide sufficient conditions for the dynamic sliding mode. Subsequently, a positive lower bound was determined to avoid the Zeno phenomenon. Finally, the validity of the scheme was verified through simulations.

articleTitle: High-resolution imaging of MIMO radar virtual arrays based on phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The resolution of radar imaging is linked to the aperture. To enhance the angular resolution by increasing the number of antennas in the array, conventional approaches come at a high hardware cost. This paper presents a novel approach that employs phase modulation of the signal and enhances phase information in the echo signal to boost antennas virtually. By utilizing the virtual array technique, it is possible to enhance the angular resolution of the MIMO radar without incurring additional hardware costs. This study offers a comprehensive analysis of the principles and models underlying this technique, and investigates its robustness by exploring various boundary conditions and potential applications.

articleTitle: Fish School Detection Algorithm Improved Based on Yolov5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Water conservancy experts obtain fish school information through analyzing sonar videos, providing objective basis for the construction of fishway and guiding their construction. In order to reduce the missed detection rate of object detection in video analysis, a position attention module was introduced on YOLOv5s to enhance the expression ability of learning features in mobile networks; Introducing a coordinate attention module allows the network to understand the spatial relationships between objects in the image, perceive coordinate information to a certain extent, and improve detection performance. Final, the enhanced model outperforms the original YOLOv5s model by improving mAP0.5:0.95 by 1.3% and Recall by 2.58%.

articleTitle: Dueling-DQN-Assisted Beam Hopping and Power Allocation with Dynamic Cache for LEO Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In the context of multi-beam Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite communication, the increasing satellite cache capability and growing user demands for data transmission have posed an important research question: how to leverage satellite caching to enhance the throughput and performance of satellite communication systems. This article introduces a satellite cache strategy based on file reference count (FRC) and file weight (FW), and employs the Dueling Deep Q-Network (DDQN) reinforcement learning algorithm for flexible allocation of on-board beams and power resources to maximize throughput. The simulation results demonstrate that our proposed dynamic cache strategy (DCS) outperforms traditional average-cache strategies (ACS) and no-cache strategies (NCS). Additionally, the use of the DDQN algorithm yields higher throughput compared to traditional Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning algorithms, thus confirming its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Dual Branch Video Quality Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Human beings predict video quality scores by simulating the perception mechanism of the Human Visual System (HVS), which has been proven to be an effective way to solve the problem of Video Quality Assessment (VQA). This article presents a new dual branch video quality evaluation method. Firstly, sample the video frames using the designed sampling method. Next, two parallel independent feature extractors are used for deep extraction of video features. These two extractors focus on different aspects of the video without interfering with each other, thus capturing the intrinsic features of the video more targeted. Then, feature fusion was achieved through the designed attention mechanism, further enhancing the model's expressive power. Finally, the features are mapped into accurate and reliable video quality scores through methods such as spatial attention and temporal attention. This article provides a comprehensive and efficient video quality assessment framework, proposing new ideas and methods for VQA.

articleTitle: Competitive-Driven Learning for Image Ordinal Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Image ordinal classification (IOC) assigns a discrete yet ordinal scalar label to an input image, such as age estimation. For IOC, it is non-trivial to effectively incorporate the ordinal information of inputs into the classification task. In this work, we adopt the concept of CutMix, a data augmentation technique that mixes two samples and their labels proportionally during the training, to help the task of ordinal classification. In particular, we study the CutMix from the perspective of metric learning instead of data augmentation, which naturally and simply implements classification learning and difference regression learning. Firstly, we embed two ordinal images into the training procedure by a virtual combination of image and label, and explain why CutMix fits IOC well. Secondly, the ordinal difference between two images is utilized to learn the fine difference in category classification, which is integrated with CutMix properly. Finally, for further improvement, dual pairing and random augmentation are proposed to enlarge the disparity of two objects, so as to exploit more discriminative feature. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our newly proposed approach, which outperforms previous methods with a relatively large margin (>2%).

articleTitle: Design of a High-Precision Current Limiting Protection Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that current limiting accuracy was easily affected by current sensing method, input voltage, temperature and process, a high-precision current limiting protection circuit was proposed. The circuit achieved current sensing through the top aluminum parasitic resistance, avoiding the introduction of additional on-resistance and power consumption. Internal supply voltage and zero temperature coefficient bias current made the current limit value independent of input voltage and temperature. The current sensing voltage and the current limit value setting voltage were processed in the comparator to response to overcurrent and short-circuit conditions. To minimize the deviation of the current limit value caused by process factors, the deviation of the current limit value was trimmed by a digital trimming circuit. The circuit is based on 0.18 µm 30V 1P3M BCD (Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS) process. Simulation results show that current limiting value varies by 0.84% from 5V to 12V and by 1.1% from −40 °C to 125 °C. The current limit value has a minimum trimmable accuracy of 0.83% and a trimmable range from −56.3% to 55.3%. Under the circumstance that the current limit value is in the range from 2A to 5A, the current limit accuracy is 3%.

articleTitle: An Automatic Drill Pipe Counting Method for Gas Drainage Based on Improved SiamRPN
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Gas drainage is one of the most effective ways to prevent the risk of gas explosion. To solve the problems of low efficiency and dependability of human experience by manual counting the number of drill pipes for gas drainage, this paper proposes an automatic counting framework for borehole depth measurement based on visual tracking. Firstly, a path-constrained approach is adopted to improve the Siamese network for real-time drilling rig tracking, addressing the problem of frequent tracking loss caused by occlusion and exposure. Then, the reciprocating motion pattern of the drilling rig is analyzed, and a parameteradaptive pipe counting scheme is proposed for complex drilling scenarios, in which the number of reciprocating motions of drilling rig for extracting a drill pipe varies. Through experiments on 20 videos collected from underground sites using different drilling equipment, our proposed scheme achieves a high accuracy rate of 99.5% for drill pipe counting in complex motion scenarios, showing excellent robustness.

articleTitle: Research on computer wireless communication technology based on machine learning algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Different services in electric power communication network have different network requirements. Traditional centralized network architecture is difficult to provide communication network services that meet all business needs. Therefore, the design of dedicated power network slicing and the construction of slice-based communication network architecture will be the future development trend of the power industry. For different power grid service scenarios, network resources need to be allocated to different service slices on demand. And guarantee the quality of service. At the same time, in the network environment, the interference of pulse noise is the key factor affecting the quality of signal transmission, and the reduction of pulse noise before signal demodulation can improve the communication quality of electric power communication network. Based on Q learning algorithm in machine learning, this paper studies resource allocation and impulse noise reduction in network slice of electric power communication network. Aiming at the low efficiency of resource allocation method in power communication network slicing, this paper proposes a method of resource allocation based on end-to-end architecture combining experience quality and resource utilization. First, the resource allocation problem is modeled as a Markov process. Then, Q learning in reinforcement learning and deep Q network algorithm are used to solve the optimal allocation scheme. The simulation results show that the resource allocation method based on Q learning and DON can meet the requirements of multi-service experience quality and improve resource utilization. In addition, the resource allocation algorithm based on DON has faster convergence speed than the resource allocation algorithm based on Q learning.

articleTitle: An Area and Power Efficient Design of Fused integer-floating point unit for RISC-V cores
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the development of intelligent algorithms and the advent of the Internet of Things era, the floating-point arithmetic unit has increasingly become an indispensable part of general-purpose processors. However, implementing additional float point unit(FPU) implies the need for a larger chip area and increased power consumption. To address the trade-off between performance, power consumption, and area in traditional floating-point arithmetic units, we propose Fused-IFPU, a structure that integrates integer and floating-point operations and supports RV32IMF. Firstly, by separating the control logic while sharing the arithmetic resources, the circuit area is significantly reduced while maintaining high computational performance. Secondly, a rational state partitioning of complex arithmetic algorithms has been employed, reducing the resource requirements and keeping the timing delays within an acceptable range. Lastly, a unified structure is adopted for floating-point division and square root operations to minimize area consumption. Synthesis report indicates that this design incurs slightly increase in timing delay but achieves a 35.81% reduction in area and a 13.97% decrease in power consumption. The benchmark results after porting it to the Hummingbird E203 platform demonstrate that the Fused-IFPU can significantly reduce area and power consumption with nearly uncompromised computational performance.

articleTitle: Apple Target Detection Task in Complex Scenes Based on Yolov5 Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, an image recognition model based on YOLOv5 and ResNet50 is proposed for the design of image recognition system of fruit picking robot. We first used YOLOv5 to identify and estimate the quantity, location, maturity, and quality of apples, and then used Resnet50-based deep learning models for further classification. Through in-depth analysis and processing of apple image data sets, our model can accurately identify apples, estimate the quantity and quality of apples, and effectively classify the maturity of apples.

articleTitle: 16-QAM Signal Transmission with Bi-GRU Equalizer in Photonic Terahertz Communication System at 325-GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: We propose a nonlinear equalization scheme for photonic terahertz communication systems based on bi-directional gated recurrent unit (bi-GRU). The simulation experiment results demonstrate that the bi-GRU equalizer enables 80Gbps 16QAM signal generation with a 325GHz terahertz band back-to-back transmission. Comparatively, the bi-GRU equalizer outperforms the constant modulus algorithm (CMA) equalizer, bi directional long short term memory (bi-LSTM) equalizer, and GRU equalizer in terms of improving the Q factor. Specifically, the bi-GRU equalizer increases the maximum Q factor by 2.05dB compared to the traditional CMA equalizer.

articleTitle: A Portable and Wearable Visual Brain-Computer Interface for Assessing Patients With Disorders of Consciousness
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The JFK Coma Recovery Scale-Revised (JFK CRSR) is a clinical behavioral method for assessing patients with disorders of consciousness (DOC). However, due to severe brain injury, the DOC patients may lack sufficient behavioral responses, leading to a relatively high clinical misdiagnosis rate of the JFK CRS-R. To address this limitation, this study developed a portable and wearable Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) to evaluate the visual tracking abilities of the DOC patients and enhance the diagnostic accuracy of the JFK CRS-R. During the experiment, patients wore an Electroencephalogram headband, and the Graphical User Interface of the BCI presented four human images with a background captured by a camera. A target human image was randomly selected, then the four images alternately flashed until the target moved to its initial position. The system guided patients to concentrate their attention on the moving target. In a case study, the BCI system was applied to a patient diagnosed with a minimally conscious state (MCS). In contrast to the lack of visual tracking behavior in CRS-R, our experiment result showed a significant accuracy of 60% achieved by the MCS patient, emphasizing the visual tracking abilities of the MCS patients and highlighting the effectiveness of the system.

articleTitle: A passive sonar buoy underwater maneuvering weak target adaptive detection method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A passive sonar buoy underwater maneuvering weak target adaptive detection method is proposed to address the difficulty of passive detection of underwater weak targets. Firstly, the dual extremum method was used to automatically construct a collaborative detection buoy group, which was used to locate underwater acoustic signals and eliminate underwater noise and interference outside the collaborative detection area; Secondly, the segmented sampling processed positioning information was projected in the horizontal and vertical directions, and the position information of the biplane was adaptively detected using pre detection tracking theory and Hough detection algorithm set, obtaining points that meet the dual accumulation threshold from noise and interference; If the detection was unsuccessful, re segment the sampling process and repeat the projection and detection process to obtain the initial detection points; Finally, using multi-level motion constraint conditions to fuse biplane point trajectories, high-precision real target trajectories were obtained, achieving passive detection of weak underwater targets. The simulation results show the overall performance of this method is superior to the existing authoritative detection methods.

articleTitle: Dynamic frequency resource allocation method based on multi-beam directional ad-hoc network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In Flying Ad-hoc Networks (FANETs), frequency resources are scarce, and factors such as node mobility, Multi-Beam Directional Antennas (MBDAs) directionality, and co-frequency interference bring impacts on achieving reliable communications. In this paper, an efficient frequency resource allocation method based on beam frequency reuse is proposed to ensure the adaptation to topology changes and solve the problem of rationally allocating limited frequency resources among multiple nodes. Simulation results show that the proposed frequency allocation method, under the priority mechanism based on spatial isolation angle and reuse frequencies, achieves distributed decision-making among nodes by coordinating frequency allocation to avoid co-frequency directional beam interference. This method addresses the common frequency band matching issue between the transceiver nodes, ensuring stability and communication quality, and contributing to the reduction of interference among co-frequency links.

articleTitle: Impulsive noise model based on stable $\alpha$-sub-Gaussian distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Noise modeling is crucial for underwater acoustic signal identification, separation and localization. The traditional Gaussian noise model is unable to fit the heavy-tailed distribution characteristics of non-Gaussian noise field. In the past, the Alpha stable distribution model was used to simulate the non-Gaussian noise. Although the Alpha stable distribution model can fit the amplitude statistics of the impulse noise well, it cannot establish the dependence between the noise samples. A stable <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha$</tex> sub-Gaussian distribution model <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{S}\alpha \text{SG})$</tex> is proposed to address the sample dependence of underwater non-Gaussian impulse noise. Based on the DeepShip real underwater ship noise, the modeling effects of the Alpha stable distribution model and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}\alpha \text{SG}$</tex> model are compared. The results show that both the Alpha stable distribution model and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}\alpha \text{SG}$</tex> model can fit the empirical amplitude distribution of the impulse noise well, but the Alpha stable distribution can only provide four-tailed shaped scatter plots; while the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}\alpha \text{SG}$</tex> model can provide elliptical shaped scatter plots, which is consistent with the performance of real underwater noise samples.

articleTitle: Research on improved diffusion algorithm based on gradient quantization in target localization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As the industrial automation field rapidly advances, the application of image processing in practical engineering becomes increasingly sophisticated. This study focuses on the target localization problem in industrial production lines, utilizing the Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) algorithm to extract the gradient direction features from images. Building upon this, we propose an improved gradient diffusion algorithm. The algorithm enhances the precision and detail of each pixel's gradient direction by identifying primary gradient directions within the pixel's neighborhood and adjusting the central pixel's gradient information. This algorithm does not require a timeconsuming training phase, enhancing the robustness of image processing. It not only addresses interference from various image acquisition environments but also improves the reliability of the localization algorithm when dealing with irregularly shaped workpieces. Our experimental results have confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed method in the precise detection and localization within industrial production. When faced with various scenarios, the accuracy of its positioning exceeds 99%, and the execution time does not exceed 0.05 seconds.

articleTitle: Research on Optical Framework Design Deduction Method in Power Communication Backbone Network Considering Service Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the complexity of optical network dynamic inference in power communication backbone network planning, a new method of optical framework design deduction considering service dynamics is proposed. Firstly, the theory and method of grid inference are described, including route construction method and hierarchical clustering theory. Secondly, this paper describes the proposed calculation method of electric power communication backbone optical network, including the basic idea and the implementation process of calculation method. Finally, the proposed method is verified by the simulation experiment. The experimental results show that the proposed method can achieve effectiveness adapted to the related services dynamics, which can flexibly support the network inference decision caused by the dynamic nature of service.

articleTitle: Stability of wide-input buck converter based on peak current mode
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In the case of cold start and load dump, the battery voltage fluctuated greatly. In order to respond quickly to such fluctuations, a wide input buck direct current to direct current (DC-DC) converter based on peak current mode control was designed. Based on the method of small signal modeling, the small signal model of buck converter in current continuous mode (CCM) was established, the closed-loop transfer function of the system was derived. By analyzing the effect of current sampling on the stability of the system and the zeros and poles position of the control-output transfer function, a piecewise slope compensation circuit was proposed to eliminate subharmonic oscillations and avoid the overcompensation; a high gain, integrated Class II compensation error amplifier circuit was designed to ensure the stability of the voltage loop. The circuit was designed based on 0.18um BCD process, the simulation results showed that the modeling and compensation methods were correct, after compensation, the low frequency gain of the loop was 63.3dB, the bandwidth was 55kHZ, the phase margin was 62.3°, and the circuit meets the requirements of stable output in the input voltage range of 4.5V∼80 V.

articleTitle: Design of Mine Sound and Light Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In response to the problem of insufficient solutions for pushing alarm information in intelligent systems during the construction of smart mines, a mining sound and light alarm system was designed, achieving two alarm methods: active alarm and linkage alarm. Among them, active alarm monitors the key data of the intelligent system according to the alarm plan, and actively controls the sound and light alarm to emit a voice and light alarm when the alarm conditions of the plan are met; Linkage alarm improves system scalability by opening the control interface of the sound and light alarm to the intelligent system. The test results show that compared to manual monitoring, the sound and light alarm system has significant improvements in accuracy and timeliness.

articleTitle: Dual-Band High-Gain Waveguide Slot Antenna Based on MEMS Electrostatic Comb Actuator
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The application of millimeter wave technology has emerged to address the existing requirements of RF communication systems, the waveguide slot antenna stands out due to its compact, reliable, and achievable. This study presents a dual-band waveguide cavity-backed slot antenna based on the radiation waveguide trapezoid slot and coupled waveguide rectangular slot. Additionally, the antenna incorporates a MEMS electrostatic comb driven the radiation waveguide with frequency tuning performance. The simulation results indicate that the antenna's return loss is below −40dB. The antenna exhibits a frequency tuning range of approximately 0.9GHz, achieves VSWR(Voltage Standing Wave Ratio)of less than 2 in the frequency ranges of 273-274GHz and 280-283GHz respectively. Additionally, the main lobe gain is greater than 11.3dB, while the side lobe electrical level is lower than −13dB. The antenna realizes low side electrical level performance and the radiation efficiency is high.

articleTitle: Power Text Mining and Classification Based on Deep Learning Hybrid Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The proposed deep learning hybrid model for power text mining and classification addresses the limitation of traditional methods that fail to reflect the significance of each word in the text during feature extraction. The model combines Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, along with an attention mechanism, to effectively extract features from power text.Firstly, CNN is used to extract local information from power text, followed by integrating the semantics of the entire text. This step helps in capturing important patterns and relationships within the text. Secondly, LSTM is employed to extract contextual features from power text, which are then enhanced by adding an attention mechanism that calculates the attention score of output information. This mechanism enables the model to focus on crucial words and phrases in the text.Finally, the output of LSTM Attention is fused with the output of CNN to create a more comprehensive representation of power text features. This approach ensures that both local and global information is considered when classifying power text. Experimental results on public datasets demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms LSTM, CNN, and their improved models in terms of accuracy and effectiveness in power text classification. The model's ability to focus on important words and phrases leads to better performance in identifying relevant information from power text.

articleTitle: Dynamic Beam Emitter Geolocation based on Multi-stage Adaptive Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The Dynamic Beam Emitter (DBE) is an emitter with a narrow beamwidth and time-varying beam rotation that can be utilized for illicit communication via satellite internet in unsupervised conditions. Therefore, it is crucial to geolocate the DBE for information security. Existing studies assume that unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) receive timely signal feedback and are guided by it. However, the current work faces the challenge of UAVs not receiving signal feedback for an extended period of time when geolocating a DBE. To overcome this challenge, we propose a UAV multi-stage adaptive search algorithm in this paper that combines Levy flight and Q-learning to accurately geolocate a DBE. Levy flight accelerates the time taken for the first signal capture from the main lobe of the DBE, while Q-learning ensures more precise geolocation. Our simulation results demonstrate that our proposed scheme outperforms standard Q-learning in terms of search time.

articleTitle: Soft Actor-Critic-Based Service Migration in Multiuser MEC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) is an emerging computing paradigm that provides abundant resource support for the next generation of the Internet of Things (IoT). When users move between edge servers with limited coverage, it is necessary to determine service migration strategies to ensure service quality. However, traditional research on service migration often oversimplifies the multi-user scenario, focusing only on the service migration of individual users. This limitation hinders these methods from achieving optimality in real MEC environments. To address this issue, this paper models the multi-user service migration scenario and focuses on exploring the impact of service migration on user latency and system energy consumption. We propose a service migration method based on the discrete version Soft Actor-Critic algorithm (SACDM). Through simulation experiments to evaluate the performance of our proposed solution, the results demonstrate our method outperforms service migration based on Deep Q-learning (DQNM) by reducing latency by approximately 11.12%. Additionally, our method also achieves a reduction in energy consumption by approximately 6.66% compared to DQNM.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Learning Resource Recommendation Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The fast-developing online learning platforms have gathered a huge amount of learning resources, which facilitates the advancement of personalized learning recommendation methods. However, the traditional recommendation methods have problems such as sparse data and cold start, which cannot effectively recommend high-quality resources for students. This paper proposes a personalized learning resource recommendation model based on knowledge graph (KG-PLRR)to improve recommendation performance. Firstly, the student's preference set is constructed, and the fusion weight and propagation vector in the process of triple entity embedding are calculated. Then, the information of propagation nodes is aggregated to the current entity node to calculate the learning resource representation and expand the learning resource feature. By using the idea of preference propagation, the student's course resource records are used as the seed set to propagate preference outward along the relationships, and their semantics are expanded to dig out the potential connections. Finally, the personalized knowledge acquisition needs of students are more fully expressed, and the accuracy of recommendation is improved. The Experimental results show that the AUC and ACC values of this model are 0.9186 and 0.8836 in SCHOLAR dataset, and 0.7898 and 0.6541 in IMOOC dataset, respectively. The comprehensive recommendation performance of personalized learning resources is better than PLRec-KGGE, KPRN, RippleNet, KGNNLS.

articleTitle: Efficient Scene Text Segmentation via Gate Mechanism and Multi-Scale Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In addressing the challenges posed by current text segmentation methods when dealing with multi-scale and irregular scene text, this paper presents an innovative approach to scene text segmentation. The proposed method leverages multiple Gated Fully Fusion Modules, facilitating adaptive weight adjustments for features at various levels and selective information aggregation. This ensures enhanced capture of multiscale text information. Additionally, a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Module further improves information capture across different scales. The incorporation of a Text Prior Module and an Enhancement Module focuses on learning text prior information and edge features, respectively, refining the precise recognition and segmentation capabilities of multi-scale text targets. Experimental evaluations on the TextSegt dataset and the Bilingual Text Segmentation dataset validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.
